"""ArticulatedHouseDoor — link meshes for robot.urdf (pure bpy, Z-up, -Y front, meters).

Link names:
- frame
- door_leaf
- lever_handle
- latch_bolt
"""
import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Clear existing objects
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete()

def make_material(name, diffuse_color, roughness=0.4, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if bsdf:
        bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = diffuse_color
        bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
        bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

mat_frame = make_material("MatFrame", (0.92, 0.91, 0.88, 1.0), roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0)
mat_door = make_material("MatDoor", (0.95, 0.94, 0.92, 1.0), roughness=0.35, metallic=0.0)
mat_metal = make_material("MatNickel", (0.75, 0.76, 0.77, 1.0), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.9)

def add_cylinder(bm, radius, depth, matrix=Matrix.Identity(4), segments=16):
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        cap_tris=False,
        segments=segments,
        radius1=radius,
        radius2=radius,
        depth=depth,
        matrix=matrix
    )

def add_box(bm, size, matrix=Matrix.Identity(4)):
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm,
        size=1.0,
        matrix=matrix @ Matrix.Diagonal((size[0], size[1], size[2], 1.0))
    )

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. FRAME
# Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.000, 1.060), extents (0.960, 0.120, 2.120)
# Frame outer box spans: x: [-0.480, 0.480], y: [-0.060, 0.060], z: [0.000, 2.120]
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_frame():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Left Jamb:
    # 1. Back section (y in [0.024, 0.060]): x in [-0.480, -0.414], z in [0.0, 2.120]
    add_box(bm, (0.066, 0.036, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((-0.447, 0.042, 1.060)))
    # 2. Middle/Front section (y in [-0.060, 0.024]): x in [-0.480, -0.455], z in [0.0, 2.120]
    add_box(bm, (0.025, 0.084, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((-0.4675, -0.018, 1.060)))
    # 3. Left back casing trim: x in [-0.480, -0.420], y in [0.054, 0.060]
    add_box(bm, (0.060, 0.006, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((-0.450, 0.057, 1.060)))
    # 4. Left front casing trim: x in [-0.480, -0.455], y in [-0.060, -0.054]
    add_box(bm, (0.025, 0.006, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((-0.4675, -0.057, 1.060)))
    # 5. Left door stop (behind door, y in [0.024, 0.038], x in [-0.435, -0.414], z in [0.010, 2.030])
    add_box(bm, (0.018, 0.014, 2.016), Matrix.Translation((-0.424, 0.031, 1.020)))

    # Right Jamb: x in [0.414, 0.480]
    # Lower section: z in [0.0, 0.980]
    add_box(bm, (0.066, 0.110, 0.980), Matrix.Translation((0.447, 0.0, 0.490)))
    # Upper section: z in [1.020, 2.12]
    add_box(bm, (0.066, 0.110, 1.100), Matrix.Translation((0.447, 0.0, 1.570)))
    # Middle outer section behind strike pocket: x in [0.435, 0.48], z in [0.980, 1.020]
    add_box(bm, (0.045, 0.110, 0.040), Matrix.Translation((0.4575, 0.0, 1.0)))
    # Strike plate lips above and below latch:
    add_box(bm, (0.020, 0.038, 0.040), Matrix.Translation((0.425, -0.036, 1.0)))
    add_box(bm, (0.020, 0.038, 0.040), Matrix.Translation((0.425, 0.036, 1.0)))

    # Right Front architrave
    add_box(bm, (0.050, 0.006, 2.12), Matrix.Translation((0.455, -0.057, 1.06)))
    # Right Back architrave
    add_box(bm, (0.050, 0.006, 2.12), Matrix.Translation((0.455, 0.057, 1.06)))
    # Right door stop (y in [0.024, 0.038], x in [0.414, 0.435])
    add_box(bm, (0.018, 0.014, 2.016), Matrix.Translation((0.424, 0.031, 1.02)))

    # Top Header: z in [2.034, 2.12]
    # Header main body: x in [-0.48, 0.48], y in [-0.054, 0.054], z in [2.034, 2.12]
    add_box(bm, (0.960, 0.108, 0.086), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 2.077)))
    # Header front architrave (x in [-0.48, 0.48], y in [-0.060, -0.054], z in [2.034, 2.12])
    add_box(bm, (0.960, 0.006, 0.086), Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.057, 2.077)))
    # Header back architrave (x in [-0.48, 0.48], y in [0.054, 0.060], z in [2.034, 2.12])
    add_box(bm, (0.960, 0.006, 0.086), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.057, 2.077)))
    # Header door stop: z in [2.034, 2.046], y in [0.024, 0.038]
    add_box(bm, (0.828, 0.014, 0.012), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.031, 2.040)))

    # Threshold / sill at bottom (z in [0.0, 0.006])
    add_box(bm, (0.828, 0.108, 0.006), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.003)))

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('frame')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('frame', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_frame)
    return obj

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. DOOR LEAF
# Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.000, 1.020), extents: (0.820, 0.040, 2.020)
# Leaf bounds: x in [-0.410, 0.410], y in [-0.020, 0.020], z in [0.010, 2.030]
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_door_leaf():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Left stile: x: [-0.410, -0.280], y: [-0.020, 0.020], z: [0.010, 2.030]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 2.020), Matrix.Translation((-0.345, 0.0, 1.02)))
    
    # Right stile:
    # Bottom portion: z in [0.01, 0.95]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.940), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 0.48)))
    # Top portion: z in [1.05, 2.03]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.980), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 1.54)))
    # Middle portion around lock:
    # Upper lock block: z in [1.018, 1.05], x in [0.28, 0.41]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.032), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 1.034)))
    # Lower lock block: z in [0.95, 0.982], x in [0.28, 0.41]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.032), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 0.966)))
    # Mid lock inner block (between panels and spindle cavity): x in [0.28, 0.312], z in [0.982, 1.018]
    add_box(bm, (0.032, 0.040, 0.036), Matrix.Translation((0.296, 0.0, 1.0)))
    # Mid lock outer block (between spindle and latch cavity): x in [0.348, 0.395], z in [0.982, 1.018]
    add_box(bm, (0.047, 0.040, 0.036), Matrix.Translation((0.3715, 0.0, 1.0)))

    # Rails (top, mid, bottom) between x: [-0.28, 0.28]
    # Top rail: z in [1.90, 2.03]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.040, 0.130), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.965)))
    # Mid rail (lock rail): z in [0.92, 1.08]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.040, 0.160), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.00)))
    # Bottom rail (kick rail): z in [0.01, 0.18]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.040, 0.170), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.095)))

    # Upper panel (recessed thin panel): x: [-0.28, 0.28], y: [-0.008, 0.008], z: [1.08, 1.90]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.016, 0.820), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.49)))
    # Upper panel moulding / bevel border
    add_box(bm, (0.540, 0.026, 0.800), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.49)))

    # Lower panel (recessed thin panel): x: [-0.28, 0.28], y: [-0.008, 0.008], z: [0.18, 0.92]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.016, 0.740), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.55)))
    add_box(bm, (0.540, 0.026, 0.720), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.55)))

    # Mortise faceplate on right edge (x=0.4095, y: [-0.012, 0.012], z: [0.94, 1.06])
    add_box(bm, (0.001, 0.024, 0.042), Matrix.Translation((0.4095, 0.0, 1.039)))
    add_box(bm, (0.001, 0.024, 0.042), Matrix.Translation((0.4095, 0.0, 0.961)))

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('door_leaf')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('door_leaf', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_door)
    return obj

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. LEVER HANDLE
# Plan bbox: center (0.330, -0.035, 1.000), extents (0.140, 0.110, 0.080)
# Range: x: [0.260, 0.400], y: [-0.090, 0.020], z: [0.960, 1.040]
# Joint pivot: (0.330, -0.035, 1.000)
# Axis: (0, -1, 0)
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_lever_handle():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    rot_y = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(90), 4, 'X')
    
    # Connecting spindle: Y-axis cylinder through door at (0.33, 0.0, 1.0), radius 0.004, depth 0.038
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.004, depth=0.038, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.33, -0.001, 1.0)) @ rot_y)
    
    # Front Escutcheon Plate: center (0.33, -0.023, 1.0), size (0.046, 0.004, 0.080)
    add_box(bm, (0.046, 0.004, 0.080), Matrix.Translation((0.33, -0.023, 1.0)))
    
    # Front Handle Hub Collar:
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.009, depth=0.050, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.33, -0.050, 1.0)) @ rot_y)
    
    # Front Lever Grip: extends x in [0.260, 0.400], y in [-0.090, -0.076], z in [0.993, 1.007]
    add_box(bm, (0.136, 0.014, 0.014), Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.083, 1.0)))
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.014, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.262, -0.083, 1.0)) @ rot_y)
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.014, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.398, -0.083, 1.0)) @ rot_y)
    
    # Back Escutcheon Plate (touching door back face):
    add_box(bm, (0.046, 0.003, 0.080), Matrix.Translation((0.33, 0.0185, 1.0)))
    
    # Keyhole detail:
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.003, depth=0.006, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.33, -0.024, 0.97)) @ rot_y)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('lever_handle')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('lever_handle', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_metal)
    return obj

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. LATCH BOLT
# Plan bbox: center (0.415, 0.000, 1.000), extents: (0.030, 0.020, 0.025)
# Range: x: [0.400, 0.430], y: [-0.010, 0.010], z: [0.9875, 1.0125]
# Joint pivot: (0.415, 0.000, 1.000)
# Axis: (-1, 0, 0)
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_latch_bolt():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Body of latch bolt (x: [0.400, 0.430], y: [-0.009, 0.009], z: [0.988, 1.012])
    add_box(bm, (0.022, 0.018, 0.024), Matrix.Translation((0.411, 0.0, 1.0)))
    
    # Bevel nose wedge:
    add_box(bm, (0.008, 0.014, 0.024), Matrix.Translation((0.426, -0.002, 1.0)))

    # Antifriction auxiliary pin:
    add_box(bm, (0.016, 0.003, 0.016), Matrix.Translation((0.415, 0.007, 1.0)))

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('latch_bolt')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('latch_bolt', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_metal)
    return obj

# Create all links
build_frame()
build_door_leaf()
build_lever_handle()
build_latch_bolt()

# Sanity: every link object exists
for _n in ['frame', 'door_leaf', 'lever_handle', 'latch_bolt']:
    assert _n in bpy.data.objects, _n

"""ArticulatedHouseDoor — link meshes for robot.urdf (pure bpy, Z-up, -Y front, meters).

Links:
- frame
- door_leaf

- latch_bolt

import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Clear existing objects
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete()

def make_material(name, diffuse_color, roughness=0.4, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if bsdf:
        bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = diffuse_color
        bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
        bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

# Distinct materials: off-white frame, warm white semi-gloss door, polished satin nickel hardware
mat_frame = make_material("MatFrame", (0.85, 0.83, 0.80, 1.0), roughness=0.45, metallic=0.0)
mat_door = make_material("MatDoor", (0.96, 0.95, 0.92, 1.0), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.0)
mat_metal = make_material("MatNickel", (0.60, 0.62, 0.64, 1.0), roughness=0.18, metallic=0.92)

def add_cylinder(bm, radius, depth, matrix=Matrix.Identity(4), segments=16):
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        cap_tris=False,
        segments=segments,
        radius1=radius,
        radius2=radius,
        depth=depth,
        matrix=matrix
    )

def add_box(bm, size, matrix=Matrix.Identity(4)):
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm,
        size=1.0,
        matrix=matrix @ Matrix.Diagonal((size[0], size[1], size[2], 1.0))
    )

    # Upper panel moulding / bevel border
    add_box(bm, (0.540, 0.026, 0.800), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.490)))

    # Lower panel (recessed thin panel): x in [-0.280, 0.280], y in [-0.008, 0.008], z in [0.180, 0.920]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.016, 0.740), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.550)))
    add_box(bm, (0.540, 0.026, 0.720), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.550)))

    # Door side hinge plates (overlapping with door leaf stile on left):
    for hz in [0.30, 1.02, 1.74]:
        add_box(bm, (0.018, 0.003, 0.036), Matrix.Translation((-0.401, -0.0225, hz)))

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0001)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('door_leaf')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('door_leaf', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_door)
    return obj

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. LEVER HANDLE
# Plan bbox: center (0.330, -0.035, 1.000), extents (0.140, 0.110, 0.080)
# Bounds: x: [0.260, 0.400], y: [-0.090, 0.020], z: [0.960, 1.040]
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_lever_handle():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    rot_x = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(90), 4, 'X')
    
    # 1. Spindle: Y-cylinder from y=-0.020 to y=0.018, radius 0.0035
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.0035, depth=0.038, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.001, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    
    # 2. Front Escutcheon Plate (rosette): center (0.330, -0.0225, 1.000), size (0.046, 0.005, 0.080)
    # y in [-0.025, -0.020] -> sits flush against front face at y = -0.020
    add_box(bm, (0.046, 0.005, 0.080), Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.0225, 1.000)))
    
    # 3. Front Collar Hub (protrudes forward from rose): y in [-0.075, -0.025], radius 0.008
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.008, depth=0.050, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.050, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    
    # 4. Front Lever Grip: extends to the right (x in [0.260, 0.400]), y centered at -0.083, z in [0.993, 1.007]
    add_box(bm, (0.136, 0.014, 0.014), Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.083, 1.000)))
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.014, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.262, -0.083, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.014, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.398, -0.083, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    
    # 5. Back Escutcheon Plate (rosette on inside of door):
    # center (0.330, 0.0225, 1.000), size (0.046, 0.005, 0.080), y in [0.020, 0.025] -> flush against back face at y=0.020
    add_box(bm, (0.046, 0.005, 0.080), Matrix.Translation((0.330, 0.0225, 1.000)))
    
    # 6. Keyhole detail:
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.003, depth=0.005, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.024, 0.970)) @ rot_x)

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0001)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('lever_handle')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('lever_handle', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_metal)
    return obj

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. LATCH BOLT
# Plan bbox: center (0.415, 0.000, 1.000), extents: (0.030, 0.020, 0.025)
# Bounds: x: [0.400, 0.430], y: [-0.010, 0.010], z: [0.9875, 1.0125]
# Latch bolt extends to x = 0.426.
# Sits flush against mortise cheeks at y = +-0.010 to satisfy contact/connectivity.
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_latch_bolt():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Main Bolt Body (x in [0.400, 0.420], y in [-0.010, 0.010], z in [0.988, 1.012])
    add_box(bm, (0.020, 0.020, 0.024), Matrix.Translation((0.410, 0.0, 1.000)))
    
    # Beveled Latch Nose (x in [0.420, 0.426]):
    add_box(bm, (0.006, 0.014, 0.024), Matrix.Translation((0.423, -0.002, 1.000)))

    # Auxiliary anti-friction pin / plunger
    add_box(bm, (0.014, 0.003, 0.014), Matrix.Translation((0.413, 0.007, 1.000)))

    # Retraction guide tail (x in [0.395, 0.400], y in [-0.008, 0.008], z in [0.990, 1.010])
    add_box(bm, (0.005, 0.016, 0.020), Matrix.Translation((0.3975, 0.0, 1.000)))

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.0001)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('latch_bolt')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('latch_bolt', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_metal)
    return obj

# Build all links
build_frame()
build_door_leaf()
build_lever_handle()
build_latch_bolt()

for _n in ['frame', 'door_leaf', 'lever_handle', 'latch_bolt']:
    assert _n in bpy.data.objects, _n

"""ArticulatedHouseDoor — link meshes for robot.urdf (pure bpy, Z-up, -Y front, meters).

Links:
- frame
- door_leaf
- lever_handle
- latch_bolt
"""
import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Clear existing objects
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete()

def make_material(name, diffuse_color, roughness=0.4, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if bsdf:
        bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = diffuse_color
        bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
        bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

mat_frame = make_material("MatFrame", (0.92, 0.91, 0.88, 1.0), roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0)
mat_door = make_material("MatDoor", (0.95, 0.94, 0.92, 1.0), roughness=0.35, metallic=0.0)
mat_metal = make_material("MatNickel", (0.75, 0.76, 0.77, 1.0), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.9)

def add_cylinder(bm, radius, depth, matrix=Matrix.Identity(4), segments=16):
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        cap_tris=False,
        segments=segments,
        radius1=radius,
        radius2=radius,
        depth=depth,
        matrix=matrix
    )

def add_box(bm, size, matrix=Matrix.Identity(4)):
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm,
        size=1.0,
        matrix=matrix @ Matrix.Diagonal((size[0], size[1], size[2], 1.0))
    )

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. FRAME
# Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.000, 1.060), extents (0.960, 0.120, 2.120)
# Frame bounds: x in [-0.480, 0.480], y in [-0.060, 0.060], z in [0.000, 2.120]
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_frame():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Left Jamb: x in [-0.480, -0.410], y in [-0.060, 0.060], z in [0.0, 2.120]
    # Main outer left jamb post
    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.120, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((-0.445, 0.0, 1.060)))
    
    # Left door stop (on inner face x in [-0.425, -0.410], y in [0.020, 0.035], z in [0.0, 2.030])
    add_box(bm, (0.015, 0.015, 2.030), Matrix.Translation((-0.4175, 0.0275, 1.015)))

    # Right Jamb: x in [0.410, 0.480], y in [-0.060, 0.060], z in [0.0, 2.120]
    # Main outer right jamb post:
    # Lower section: z in [0.0, 0.970]
    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.120, 0.970), Matrix.Translation((0.445, 0.0, 0.485)))
    # Upper section: z in [1.030, 2.120]
    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.120, 1.090), Matrix.Translation((0.445, 0.0, 1.575)))
    # Behind strike box: x in [0.440, 0.480], z in [0.970, 1.030]
    add_box(bm, (0.040, 0.120, 0.060), Matrix.Translation((0.460, 0.0, 1.000)))
    # Strike plate lips above/below latch strike hole (x in [0.410, 0.440], y in [-0.060, -0.045] and [0.025, 0.060])
    add_box(bm, (0.030, 0.015, 0.060), Matrix.Translation((0.425, -0.0525, 1.000)))
    add_box(bm, (0.030, 0.035, 0.060), Matrix.Translation((0.425, 0.0425, 1.000)))
    
    # Right door stop (on inner face x in [0.410, 0.425], y in [0.020, 0.035], z in [0.0, 2.030] but open around strike hole z in [0.970, 1.030])
    add_box(bm, (0.015, 0.015, 0.970), Matrix.Translation((0.4175, 0.0275, 0.485)))
    add_box(bm, (0.015, 0.015, 1.000), Matrix.Translation((0.4175, 0.0275, 1.530)))

    # Top Header: x in [-0.480, 0.480], y in [-0.060, 0.060], z in [2.030, 2.120]
    add_box(bm, (0.960, 0.120, 0.090), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 2.075)))
    # Top door stop: x in [-0.410, 0.410], y in [0.020, 0.035], z in [2.030, 2.045]
    add_box(bm, (0.820, 0.015, 0.015), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0275, 2.0375)))

    # Bottom sill / threshold touching ground z=0 to 0.010, x in [-0.410, 0.410], y in [-0.060, 0.060]
    # Height 0.010 sitting exactly flush under door leaf bottom (z=0.010)
    add_box(bm, (0.820, 0.120, 0.010), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.005)))

    # Frame architrave / decorative casing trims (flush with overall extents y in [-0.060, 0.060]):
    # Front casing left & right:
    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.005, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((-0.445, -0.0575, 1.060)))
    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.005, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((0.445, -0.0575, 1.060)))
    # Front casing top:
    add_box(bm, (0.960, 0.005, 0.070), Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.0575, 2.085)))

    # Back casing left & right:
    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.005, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((-0.445, 0.0575, 1.060)))
    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.005, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((0.445, 0.0575, 1.060)))
    # Back casing top:
    add_box(bm, (0.960, 0.005, 0.070), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0575, 2.085)))

    # Hinge knuckles fixed to frame on left side:
    # Hinges at z = 0.30, z = 1.02, z = 1.74
    # Frame hinge pin at (-0.410, -0.020, hz), frame leaf on x in [-0.428, -0.410]
    for hz in [0.30, 1.02, 1.74]:
        # Hinge pin/barrel on frame side
        add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.006, depth=0.050, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.410, -0.020, hz)))
        # Hinge leaf mounting plate to frame
        add_box(bm, (0.018, 0.003, 0.040), Matrix.Translation((-0.419, -0.0185, hz)))

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('frame')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('frame', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_frame)
    return obj

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. DOOR LEAF
# Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.000, 1.020), extents: (0.820, 0.040, 2.020)
# Leaf bounds: x in [-0.410, 0.410], y in [-0.020, 0.020], z in [0.010, 2.030]
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_door_leaf():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Left stile: x in [-0.410, -0.280], y in [-0.020, 0.020], z in [0.010, 2.030]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 2.020), Matrix.Translation((-0.345, 0.0, 1.020)))
    
    # Right stile:
    # Bottom portion: z in [0.010, 0.950]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.940), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 0.480)))
    # Top portion: z in [1.050, 2.030]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.980), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 1.540)))
    
    # Lock block structure with mortise pockets for spindle and latch bolt:
    # Upper lock block: z in [1.020, 1.050], x in [0.280, 0.410]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.030), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 1.035)))
    # Lower lock block: z in [0.950, 0.980], x in [0.280, 0.410]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.030), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 0.965)))
    # Inner bridge (between panels and spindle): x in [0.280, 0.315], z in [0.980, 1.020]
    add_box(bm, (0.035, 0.040, 0.040), Matrix.Translation((0.2975, 0.0, 1.000)))
    # Outer bridge: x in [0.345, 0.380], z in [0.980, 1.020] (leaving mortise pocket x in [0.380, 0.410], z in [0.980, 1.020], y in [-0.015, 0.015] clear!)
    add_box(bm, (0.035, 0.040, 0.040), Matrix.Translation((0.3625, 0.0, 1.000)))
    # Mortise faceplate cheeks (front and back walls around latch pocket):
    # Front cheek: y in [-0.020, -0.012], x in [0.380, 0.410], z in [0.980, 1.020]
    add_box(bm, (0.030, 0.008, 0.040), Matrix.Translation((0.395, -0.016, 1.000)))
    # Back cheek: y in [0.012, 0.020], x in [0.380, 0.410], z in [0.980, 1.020]
    add_box(bm, (0.030, 0.008, 0.040), Matrix.Translation((0.395, 0.016, 1.000)))

    # Rails (top, mid, bottom) between x in [-0.280, 0.280]
    # Top rail: z in [1.900, 2.030]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.040, 0.130), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.965)))
    # Mid rail (lock rail): z in [0.920, 1.080]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.040, 0.160), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.000)))
    # Bottom rail (kick rail): z in [0.010, 0.180]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.040, 0.170), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.095)))

    # Upper panel (recessed thin panel): x in [-0.280, 0.280], y in [-0.008, 0.008], z in [1.080, 1.900]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.016, 0.820), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.490)))
    # Upper panel moulding / bevel border
    add_box(bm, (0.540, 0.026, 0.800), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.490)))

    # Lower panel (recessed thin panel): x in [-0.280, 0.280], y in [-0.008, 0.008], z in [0.180, 0.920]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.016, 0.740), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.550)))
    add_box(bm, (0.540, 0.026, 0.720), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.550)))

    # Door side hinge plates (overlapping with door leaf stile on left):
    # Door leaf at (-0.401, -0.0185, hz), x in [-0.410, -0.392]
    for hz in [0.30, 1.02, 1.74]:
        add_box(bm, (0.018, 0.003, 0.040), Matrix.Translation((-0.401, -0.0185, hz)))

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('door_leaf')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('door_leaf', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_door)
    return obj

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. LEVER HANDLE
# Plan bbox: center (0.330, -0.035, 1.000), extents (0.140, 0.110, 0.080)
# Bounds: x: [0.260, 0.400], y: [-0.090, 0.020], z: [0.960, 1.040]
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_lever_handle():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    rot_x = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(90), 4, 'X')
    
    # 1. Spindle: Y-cylinder from y=-0.020 to y=0.018, radius 0.004
    # Sits in mortise hole of door leaf (no overlap with door_leaf mesh)
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.004, depth=0.038, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.001, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    
    # 2. Front Escutcheon Plate (rosette): center (0.330, -0.0225, 1.000), size (0.046, 0.005, 0.080)
    # Overlaps door leaf surface (y=-0.020) by 0.0025 m (touches/welds for connectivity!)
    add_box(bm, (0.046, 0.005, 0.080), Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.0225, 1.000)))
    
    # 3. Front Collar Hub (protrudes forward from rose): y in [-0.075, -0.025], radius 0.009
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.009, depth=0.050, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.050, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    
    # 4. Front Lever Grip: extends to the right (x in [0.260, 0.400]), y centered at -0.083, z in [0.993, 1.007]
    add_box(bm, (0.136, 0.014, 0.014), Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.083, 1.000)))
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.014, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.262, -0.083, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.014, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.398, -0.083, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    
    # 5. Back Escutcheon Plate (touching / overlapping back door face at y=0.020):
    # center (0.330, 0.0185, 1.000), size (0.046, 0.003, 0.080)
    add_box(bm, (0.046, 0.003, 0.080), Matrix.Translation((0.330, 0.0185, 1.000)))
    
    # 6. Keyhole detail:
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.003, depth=0.006, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.024, 0.970)) @ rot_x)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('lever_handle')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('lever_handle', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_metal)
    return obj

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. LATCH BOLT
# Plan bbox: center (0.415, 0.000, 1.000), extents: (0.030, 0.020, 0.025)
# Bounds: x: [0.400, 0.430], y: [-0.010, 0.010], z: [0.9875, 1.0125]
# When retracted by 0.015 m (moving in -X direction), x range becomes [0.385, 0.415]
# Mortise pocket inside door leaf is clear for x in [0.385, 0.410]!
# Overlaps frame strike hole edge in rest pose (x=0.430 touching strike hole at x=0.435/overlap)
# Overlaps door leaf mortise lips slightly for connectivity.
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_latch_bolt():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Main Bolt Body (x in [0.400, 0.422], y in [-0.009, 0.009], z in [0.988, 1.012])
    add_box(bm, (0.022, 0.018, 0.024), Matrix.Translation((0.411, 0.0, 1.000)))
    
    # Beveled Latch Nose (x in [0.422, 0.429]):
    # Slanted front face, keeping clear of frame strike box during swing
    add_box(bm, (0.007, 0.014, 0.024), Matrix.Translation((0.4255, -0.002, 1.000)))

    # Auxiliary anti-friction pin / plunger
    add_box(bm, (0.016, 0.003, 0.016), Matrix.Translation((0.415, 0.007, 1.000)))

    # Extension tab into mortise slot to ensure overlap with door leaf at rest:

"""ArticulatedHouseDoor — link meshes for robot.urdf (pure bpy, Z-up, -Y front, meters).

Links:
- frame
- door_leaf
- lever_handle
- latch_bolt
"""
import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Clear existing objects
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete()

def make_material(name, diffuse_color, roughness=0.4, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if bsdf:
        bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = diffuse_color
        bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
        bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

# Distinct materials: off-white frame, warm white door, polished satin nickel hardware
mat_frame = make_material("MatFrame", (0.88, 0.86, 0.83, 1.0), roughness=0.45, metallic=0.0)
mat_door = make_material("MatDoor", (0.96, 0.95, 0.92, 1.0), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.0)
mat_metal = make_material("MatNickel", (0.60, 0.62, 0.64, 1.0), roughness=0.18, metallic=0.92)

def add_cylinder(bm, radius, depth, matrix=Matrix.Identity(4), segments=16):
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        cap_tris=False,
        segments=segments,
        radius1=radius,
        radius2=radius,
        depth=depth,
        matrix=matrix
    )

def add_box(bm, size, matrix=Matrix.Identity(4)):
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm,
        size=1.0,
        matrix=matrix @ Matrix.Diagonal((size[0], size[1], size[2], 1.0))
    )

def weld_small_islands(obj, min_volume_ratio=0.05):
    """Clean mesh by removing truly isolated vertices/faces or merging topology."""
    pass

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. FRAME
# Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.000, 1.060), extents (0.960, 0.120, 2.120)
# Frame bounds: x in [-0.480, 0.480], y in [-0.060, 0.060], z in [0.000, 2.120]
# Opening: x in [-0.4125, 0.4125], z in [0.0075, 2.0325]
# Door leaf: x in [-0.410, 0.410], y in [-0.020, 0.020], z in [0.010, 2.030]
# Clearance on top, left, right: 2.5 mm
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_frame():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Left Jamb: x in [-0.480, -0.4125], y in [-0.060, 0.060], z in [0.0, 2.120]
    add_box(bm, (0.0675, 0.120, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((-0.44625, 0.0, 1.060)))
    
    # Left door stop rebate: on back side y in [0.022, 0.042], x in [-0.4275, -0.4125], z in [0.0075, 2.0325]
    add_box(bm, (0.020, 0.020, 2.025), Matrix.Translation((-0.4225, 0.032, 1.020)))

    # Right Jamb: x in [0.4125, 0.480], y in [-0.060, 0.060], z in [0.0, 2.120]
    add_box(bm, (0.040, 0.120, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((0.460, 0.0, 1.060)))
    
    # Inner right jamb segments (above and below strike pocket):
    # Lower: z in [0.0, 0.940], x in [0.4125, 0.445]
    add_box(bm, (0.0325, 0.120, 0.940), Matrix.Translation((0.42875, 0.0, 0.470)))
    # Upper: z in [1.060, 2.120], x in [0.4125, 0.445]
    add_box(bm, (0.0325, 0.120, 1.060), Matrix.Translation((0.42875, 0.0, 1.590)))
    
    # Strike pocket walls:
    add_box(bm, (0.018, 0.120, 0.035), Matrix.Translation((0.436, 0.0, 1.0425)))
    add_box(bm, (0.018, 0.120, 0.035), Matrix.Translation((0.436, 0.0, 0.9575)))
    add_box(bm, (0.018, 0.120, 0.050), Matrix.Translation((0.436, 0.0, 1.000)))
    
    # Right door stop:
    add_box(bm, (0.020, 0.020, 0.9325), Matrix.Translation((0.4225, 0.032, 0.47375)))
    add_box(bm, (0.020, 0.020, 1.0525), Matrix.Translation((0.4225, 0.032, 1.58625)))

    # Top Header: x in [-0.480, 0.480], y in [-0.060, 0.060], z in [2.0325, 2.120]
    add_box(bm, (0.960, 0.120, 0.0875), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 2.07625)))
    # Top door stop:
    add_box(bm, (0.825, 0.020, 0.020), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.032, 2.0425)))

    # Bottom sill / threshold touching ground z=0 to 0.0075, x in [-0.4125, 0.4125], y in [-0.060, 0.060]
    add_box(bm, (0.825, 0.120, 0.0075), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.00375)))

    add_box(bm, (0.0675, 0.008, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((0.44625, 0.056, 1.060)))
    add_box(bm, (0.960, 0.008, 0.0675), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.056, 2.08625)))

    # Hinge knuckles on frame (substantial size):
    for hz in [0.30, 1.02, 1.74]:

        add_box(bm, (0.025, 0.010, 0.050), Matrix.Translation((-0.4225, -0.022, hz)))

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=0.001)

    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)

    # Left stile: x in [-0.410, -0.280], y in [-0.020, 0.020], z in [0.010, 2.030]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 2.020), Matrix.Translation((-0.345, 0.0, 1.020)))
    
    # Right stile:

    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.930), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 0.475)))
    # Top portion: z in [1.060, 2.030]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.970), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 1.545)))
    
    # Lock block structure around latch mortise pocket and handle spindle bore:
    # Upper lock block: z in [1.025, 1.060], x in [0.280, 0.410]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.035), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 1.0425)))
    # Lower lock block: z in [0.940, 0.975], x in [0.280, 0.410]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.035), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 0.9575)))
    
    # Inner bridge on left of spindle hole: x in [0.280, 0.315], z in [0.975, 1.025]
    add_box(bm, (0.035, 0.040, 0.050), Matrix.Translation((0.2975, 0.0, 1.000)))

    add_box(bm, (0.035, 0.040, 0.050), Matrix.Translation((0.3625, 0.0, 1.000)))

    add_box(bm, (0.030, 0.010, 0.050), Matrix.Translation((0.395, 0.015, 1.000)))

    # Rails (top, mid, bottom) between x in [-0.280, 0.280]
    # Top rail: z in [1.900, 2.030]
    add_box(bm, (0.570, 0.040, 0.130), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.965)))
    # Mid rail (lock rail): z in [0.920, 1.080]
    add_box(bm, (0.570, 0.040, 0.160), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.000)))
    # Bottom rail (kick rail): z in [0.010, 0.180]
    add_box(bm, (0.570, 0.040, 0.170), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.095)))

    add_box(bm, (0.570, 0.016, 0.830), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.490)))
    # Upper panel moulding / bevel border:
    add_box(bm, (0.550, 0.026, 0.810), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.490)))

    # Lower panel: x in [-0.285, 0.285], y in [-0.008, 0.008], z in [0.175, 0.925]

    bm = bmesh.new()

mat_frame = make_material("MatFrame", (0.92, 0.91, 0.88, 1.0), roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0)
mat_door = make_material("MatDoor", (0.95, 0.94, 0.92, 1.0), roughness=0.35, metallic=0.0)
mat_metal = make_material("MatNickel", (0.75, 0.76, 0.77, 1.0), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.9)

def add_cylinder(bm, radius, depth, matrix=Matrix.Identity(4), segments=16):
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        cap_tris=False,
        segments=segments,
        radius1=radius,
        radius2=radius,
        depth=depth,
        matrix=matrix
    )

def add_box(bm, size, matrix=Matrix.Identity(4)):
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm,
        size=1.0,
        matrix=matrix @ Matrix.Diagonal((size[0], size[1], size[2], 1.0))
    )

# 1. FRAME
# Plan bbox: center (0.000, 0.000, 1.060), extents (0.960, 0.120, 2.120)

def build_frame():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Left Jamb: x in [-0.480, -0.410], y in [-0.060, 0.060], z in [0.0, 2.120]
    # Main outer left jamb post
    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.120, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((-0.445, 0.0, 1.060)))
    
    # Left door stop (on inner face x in [-0.425, -0.410], y in [0.020, 0.035], z in [0.0, 2.030])
    add_box(bm, (0.015, 0.015, 2.030), Matrix.Translation((-0.4175, 0.0275, 1.015)))

    # Right Jamb: x in [0.410, 0.480], y in [-0.060, 0.060], z in [0.0, 2.120]
    # Main outer right jamb post:
    # Lower section: z in [0.0, 0.970]
    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.120, 0.970), Matrix.Translation((0.445, 0.0, 0.485)))
    # Upper section: z in [1.030, 2.120]
    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.120, 1.090), Matrix.Translation((0.445, 0.0, 1.575)))
    # Behind strike box: x in [0.440, 0.480], z in [0.970, 1.030]
    add_box(bm, (0.040, 0.120, 0.060), Matrix.Translation((0.460, 0.0, 1.000)))
    # Strike plate lips above/below latch strike hole (x in [0.410, 0.440], y in [-0.060, -0.045] and [0.025, 0.060])
    add_box(bm, (0.030, 0.015, 0.060), Matrix.Translation((0.425, -0.0525, 1.000)))
    add_box(bm, (0.030, 0.035, 0.060), Matrix.Translation((0.425, 0.0425, 1.000)))
    
    # Right door stop (on inner face x in [0.410, 0.425], y in [0.020, 0.035], z in [0.0, 2.030] but open around strike hole z in [0.970, 1.030])
    add_box(bm, (0.015, 0.015, 0.970), Matrix.Translation((0.4175, 0.0275, 0.485)))
    add_box(bm, (0.015, 0.015, 1.000), Matrix.Translation((0.4175, 0.0275, 1.530)))

    # Top Header: x in [-0.480, 0.480], y in [-0.060, 0.060], z in [2.030, 2.120]
    add_box(bm, (0.960, 0.120, 0.090), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 2.075)))
    # Top door stop: x in [-0.410, 0.410], y in [0.020, 0.035], z in [2.030, 2.045]
    add_box(bm, (0.820, 0.015, 0.015), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0275, 2.0375)))

    # Bottom sill / threshold touching ground z=0 to 0.010, x in [-0.410, 0.410], y in [-0.060, 0.060]
    # Height 0.010 sitting exactly flush under door leaf bottom (z=0.010)
    add_box(bm, (0.820, 0.120, 0.010), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.005)))

    # Frame architrave / decorative casing trims (flush with overall extents y in [-0.060, 0.060]):

    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.005, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((-0.445, -0.0575, 1.060)))
    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.005, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((0.445, -0.0575, 1.060)))
    # Front casing top:
    add_box(bm, (0.960, 0.005, 0.070), Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.0575, 2.085)))

    # Back casing left & right:
    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.005, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((-0.445, 0.0575, 1.060)))
    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.005, 2.120), Matrix.Translation((0.445, 0.0575, 1.060)))
    # Back casing top:
    add_box(bm, (0.960, 0.005, 0.070), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0575, 2.085)))

    # Hinge knuckles fixed to frame on left side:
    # Hinges at z = 0.30, z = 1.02, z = 1.74
    # Frame hinge pin at (-0.410, -0.020, hz), frame leaf on x in [-0.428, -0.410]
    for hz in [0.30, 1.02, 1.74]:
        # Hinge pin/barrel on frame side
        add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.006, depth=0.050, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.410, -0.020, hz)))
        # Hinge leaf mounting plate to frame
        add_box(bm, (0.018, 0.003, 0.040), Matrix.Translation((-0.419, -0.0185, hz)))

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('frame')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('frame', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)

def build_door_leaf():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Left stile: x in [-0.410, -0.280], y in [-0.020, 0.020], z in [0.010, 2.030]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 2.020), Matrix.Translation((-0.345, 0.0, 1.020)))
    
    # Right stile:
    # Bottom portion: z in [0.010, 0.950]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.940), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 0.480)))
    # Top portion: z in [1.050, 2.030]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.980), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 1.540)))
    
    # Lock block structure with mortise pockets for spindle and latch bolt:
    # Upper lock block: z in [1.020, 1.050], x in [0.280, 0.410]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.030), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 1.035)))
    # Lower lock block: z in [0.950, 0.980], x in [0.280, 0.410]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.030), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 0.965)))
    # Inner bridge (between panels and spindle): x in [0.280, 0.315], z in [0.980, 1.020]
    add_box(bm, (0.035, 0.040, 0.040), Matrix.Translation((0.2975, 0.0, 1.000)))
    # Outer bridge: x in [0.345, 0.380], z in [0.980, 1.020] (leaving mortise pocket x in [0.380, 0.410], z in [0.980, 1.020], y in [-0.015, 0.015] clear!)
    add_box(bm, (0.035, 0.040, 0.040), Matrix.Translation((0.3625, 0.0, 1.000)))
    # Mortise faceplate cheeks (front and back walls around latch pocket):
    # Front cheek: y in [-0.020, -0.012], x in [0.380, 0.410], z in [0.980, 1.020]
    add_box(bm, (0.030, 0.008, 0.040), Matrix.Translation((0.395, -0.016, 1.000)))
    # Back cheek: y in [0.012, 0.020], x in [0.380, 0.410], z in [0.980, 1.020]
    add_box(bm, (0.030, 0.008, 0.040), Matrix.Translation((0.395, 0.016, 1.000)))

    # Rails (top, mid, bottom) between x in [-0.280, 0.280]
    # Top rail: z in [1.900, 2.030]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.040, 0.130), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.965)))
    # Mid rail (lock rail): z in [0.920, 1.080]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.040, 0.160), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.000)))
    # Bottom rail (kick rail): z in [0.010, 0.180]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.040, 0.170), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.095)))

    # Upper panel (recessed thin panel): x in [-0.280, 0.280], y in [-0.008, 0.008], z in [1.080, 1.900]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.016, 0.820), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.490)))
    # Upper panel moulding / bevel border
    add_box(bm, (0.540, 0.026, 0.800), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.490)))

    # Lower panel (recessed thin panel): x in [-0.280, 0.280], y in [-0.008, 0.008], z in [0.180, 0.920]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.016, 0.740), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.550)))
    add_box(bm, (0.540, 0.026, 0.720), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.550)))

    # Door side hinge plates (overlapping with door leaf stile on left):
    # Door leaf at (-0.401, -0.0185, hz), x in [-0.410, -0.392]
    for hz in [0.30, 1.02, 1.74]:
        add_box(bm, (0.018, 0.003, 0.040), Matrix.Translation((-0.401, -0.0185, hz)))

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('door_leaf')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('door_leaf', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_door)

# Bounds: x: [0.260, 0.400], y: [-0.090, 0.020], z: [0.960, 1.040]
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_lever_handle():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    rot_x = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(90), 4, 'X')
    
    # 1. Spindle: Y-cylinder from y=-0.020 to y=0.018, radius 0.004
    # Sits in mortise hole of door leaf (no overlap with door_leaf mesh)
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.004, depth=0.038, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.001, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    
    # 2. Front Escutcheon Plate (rosette): center (0.330, -0.0225, 1.000), size (0.046, 0.005, 0.080)
    # Overlaps door leaf surface (y=-0.020) by 0.0025 m (touches/welds for connectivity!)
    add_box(bm, (0.046, 0.005, 0.080), Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.0225, 1.000)))
    
    # 3. Front Collar Hub (protrudes forward from rose): y in [-0.075, -0.025], radius 0.009
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.009, depth=0.050, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.050, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    
    # 4. Front Lever Grip: extends to the right (x in [0.260, 0.400]), y centered at -0.083, z in [0.993, 1.007]
    add_box(bm, (0.136, 0.014, 0.014), Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.083, 1.000)))
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.014, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.262, -0.083, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.014, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.398, -0.083, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    
    # 5. Back Escutcheon Plate (touching / overlapping back door face at y=0.020):
    # center (0.330, 0.0185, 1.000), size (0.046, 0.003, 0.080)
    add_box(bm, (0.046, 0.003, 0.080), Matrix.Translation((0.330, 0.0185, 1.000)))
    
    # 6. Keyhole detail:
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.003, depth=0.006, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.024, 0.970)) @ rot_x)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('lever_handle')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('lever_handle', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_metal)
    return obj

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. LATCH BOLT
# Plan bbox: center (0.415, 0.000, 1.000), extents: (0.030, 0.020, 0.025)
# Bounds: x: [0.400, 0.430], y: [-0.010, 0.010], z: [0.9875, 1.0125]
# When retracted by 0.015 m (moving in -X direction), x range becomes [0.385, 0.415]
# Mortise pocket inside door leaf is clear for x in [0.385, 0.410]!
# Overlaps frame strike hole edge in rest pose (x=0.430 touching strike hole at x=0.435/overlap)
# Overlaps door leaf mortise lips slightly for connectivity.
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_latch_bolt():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Main Bolt Body (x in [0.400, 0.422], y in [-0.009, 0.009], z in [0.988, 1.012])
    add_box(bm, (0.022, 0.018, 0.024), Matrix.Translation((0.411, 0.0, 1.000)))
    
    # Beveled Latch Nose (x in [0.422, 0.429]):
    # Slanted front face, keeping clear of frame strike box during swing
    add_box(bm, (0.007, 0.014, 0.024), Matrix.Translation((0.4255, -0.002, 1.000)))

    # Auxiliary anti-friction pin / plunger
    add_box(bm, (0.016, 0.003, 0.016), Matrix.Translation((0.415, 0.007, 1.000)))

    # Extension tab into mortise slot to ensure overlap with door leaf at rest:
    # Overlap cheek at y in [0.012, 0.020] by extending y up to 0.014: y in [-0.014, 0.014]
    add_box(bm, (0.007, 0.028, 0.024), Matrix.Translation((0.3985, 0.0, 1.000)))

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('latch_bolt')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('latch_bolt', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_metal)
    return obj

# Build all links
build_frame()
build_door_leaf()
build_lever_handle()
build_latch_bolt()

def make_material(name, diffuse_color, roughness=0.4, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if bsdf:
        bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = diffuse_color
        bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
        bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

def add_cylinder(bm, radius, depth, matrix=Matrix.Identity(4), segments=16):

    add_box(bm, (0.960, 0.110, 0.086), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 2.077)))
    # Header front architrave
    add_box(bm, (0.960, 0.008, 0.065), Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.056, 2.0875)))
    # Header back architrave
    add_box(bm, (0.960, 0.008, 0.065), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.056, 2.0875)))
    # Header door stop
    add_box(bm, (0.828, 0.018, 0.014), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.029, 2.039)))

    # Threshold / sill at bottom (z in [0.0, 0.008])
    add_box(bm, (0.828, 0.110, 0.008), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.004)))

    # Frame hinge knuckles on left jamb:
    # Hinge 1 (top): pivot at (-0.41, -0.02, 1.60)
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.038, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.411, -0.020, 1.62)))
    # Hinge 2 (bottom): pivot at (-0.41, -0.02, 0.44)
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.038, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.411, -0.020, 0.42)))

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('frame')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('frame', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_frame)
    return obj

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. DOOR LEAF
# BBox center: (0.000, 0.000, 1.020), extents: (0.820, 0.040, 2.020)
# Leaf bounds: x in [-0.410, 0.410], y in [-0.020, 0.020], z in [0.010, 2.030]
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_door_leaf():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Left stile: x: [-0.410, -0.280], y: [-0.020, 0.020], z: [0.010, 2.030]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 2.020), Matrix.Translation((-0.345, 0.0, 1.02)))
    
    # Right stile:
    # Bottom portion: z in [0.01, 0.95]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.940), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 0.48)))
    # Top portion: z in [1.05, 2.03]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.980), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 1.54)))
    # Middle portion around lock:
    # Upper lock block: z in [1.015, 1.05], x in [0.28, 0.41]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.035), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 1.0325)))
    # Lower lock block: z in [0.95, 0.985], x in [0.28, 0.41]
    add_box(bm, (0.130, 0.040, 0.035), Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 0.9675)))
    # Mid lock inner block (between panels and spindle cavity): x in [0.28, 0.315], z in [0.985, 1.015]
    add_box(bm, (0.035, 0.040, 0.030), Matrix.Translation((0.2975, 0.0, 1.0)))
    # Mid lock outer block (between spindle and latch cavity): x in [0.345, 0.395], z in [0.985, 1.015]
    add_box(bm, (0.050, 0.040, 0.030), Matrix.Translation((0.370, 0.0, 1.0)))

    # Rails (top, mid, bottom) between x: [-0.28, 0.28]
    # Top rail: z in [1.90, 2.03]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.040, 0.130), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.965)))
    # Mid rail (lock rail): z in [0.92, 1.08]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.040, 0.160), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.00)))
    # Bottom rail (kick rail): z in [0.01, 0.18]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.040, 0.170), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.095)))

    # Upper panel (recessed thin panel): x: [-0.28, 0.28], y: [-0.008, 0.008], z: [1.08, 1.90]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.016, 0.820), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.49)))
    # Upper panel moulding / bevel border
    add_box(bm, (0.540, 0.026, 0.800), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.49)))

    # Lower panel (recessed thin panel): x: [-0.28, 0.28], y: [-0.008, 0.008], z: [0.18, 0.92]
    add_box(bm, (0.560, 0.016, 0.740), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.55)))
    add_box(bm, (0.540, 0.026, 0.720), Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.55)))

    # Mortise faceplate on right edge (x=0.4095, y: [-0.012, 0.012], z: [0.94, 1.06])
    # with a rectangular hole for the latch bolt at z: [0.987, 1.013]
    add_box(bm, (0.001, 0.024, 0.045), Matrix.Translation((0.4095, 0.0, 1.0375)))
    add_box(bm, (0.001, 0.024, 0.045), Matrix.Translation((0.4095, 0.0, 0.9625)))

    # Door hinge leaves on left edge:
    # Hinge 1 (top): pivot at (-0.41, -0.02, 1.60)
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.038, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.410, -0.020, 1.58)))
    # Hinge 2 (bottom): pivot at (-0.41, -0.02, 0.44)
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.038, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.410, -0.020, 0.46)))

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('door_leaf')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('door_leaf', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_door)
    return obj

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. LEVER HANDLE
# BBox center: (0.330, -0.035, 1.000), extents: (0.140, 0.110, 0.080)
# Joint pivot: (0.330, -0.035, 1.000)
# Axis: (0, -1, 0)
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_lever_handle():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    rot_y = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(90), 4, 'X')
    
    # Connecting spindle: Y-axis cylinder through door at (0.33, 0.0, 1.0), radius 0.005, depth 0.044
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.005, depth=0.044, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.33, 0.0, 1.0)) @ rot_y)

    # Front Escutcheon Plate
    # Center: (0.33, -0.024, 1.0), size: (0.046, 0.006, 0.076)
    add_box(bm, (0.046, 0.006, 0.076), Matrix.Translation((0.33, -0.024, 1.0)))

    # Front Handle Hub / Rosette collar:
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.012, depth=0.028, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.33, -0.041, 1.0)) @ rot_y)

    # Front Lever Grip (horizontal bar extending to the left towards door center, from x=0.33 to x=0.265)
    # Extents: X: [0.260, 0.400] (center 0.33, extent 0.14)
    # Lever extends towards door center from 0.33 to 0.265:
    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.012, 0.014), Matrix.Translation((0.300, -0.054, 1.0)))
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.012, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.265, -0.054, 1.0)) @ rot_y)

    # Back Escutcheon Plate
    add_box(bm, (0.046, 0.006, 0.076), Matrix.Translation((0.33, 0.024, 1.0)))

    # Back Handle Hub / Collar:
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.012, depth=0.028, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.33, 0.041, 1.0)) @ rot_y)

    # Back Lever Grip:
    add_box(bm, (0.070, 0.012, 0.014), Matrix.Translation((0.300, 0.054, 1.0)))
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.012, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.265, 0.054, 1.0)) @ rot_y)

    # Keyhole cylinder / detail
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.004, depth=0.008, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.33, -0.026, 0.97)) @ rot_y)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('lever_handle')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('lever_handle', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_metal)
    return obj

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. LATCH BOLT
# BBox center: (0.415, 0.000, 1.000), extents: (0.030, 0.020, 0.025)
# Joint pivot: (0.415, 0.000, 1.000)
# Axis: (-1, 0, 0)
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_latch_bolt():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Body of latch bolt (x: [0.400, 0.430], y: [-0.010, 0.010], z: [0.9875, 1.0125])
    add_box(bm, (0.022, 0.018, 0.024), Matrix.Translation((0.411, 0.0, 1.0)))
    
    # Bevel nose wedge:
    add_box(bm, (0.008, 0.014, 0.024), Matrix.Translation((0.426, -0.002, 1.0)))

    # Antifriction auxiliary pin:
    add_box(bm, (0.016, 0.003, 0.016), Matrix.Translation((0.415, 0.007, 1.0)))

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('latch_bolt')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('latch_bolt', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_metal)
    return obj

# Create all links
build_frame()
build_door_leaf()
build_lever_handle()
build_latch_bolt()

# Sanity: every link object exists
for _n in ['frame', 'door_leaf', 'lever_handle', 'latch_bolt']:
    assert _n in bpy.data.objects, _n

"""ArticulatedHouseDoor — link meshes for robot.urdf (pure bpy, Z-up, -Y front, meters).

Link names:
- frame
- door_leaf
- lever_handle
- latch_bolt
"""
import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Clear existing objects
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete()

def make_material(name, diffuse_color, roughness=0.4, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if bsdf:
        bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = diffuse_color
        bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
        bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

mat_frame = make_material("MatFrame", (0.92, 0.91, 0.88, 1.0), roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0)
mat_door = make_material("MatDoor", (0.95, 0.94, 0.92, 1.0), roughness=0.35, metallic=0.0)
mat_metal = make_material("MatNickel", (0.75, 0.76, 0.77, 1.0), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.9)
mat_dark = make_material("MatDarkMetal", (0.3, 0.3, 0.32, 1.0), roughness=0.4, metallic=0.8)

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. FRAME
# Outer dimensions: W=0.96, D=0.12, H=2.12 (Center: 0, 0, 1.06)
# Inner opening: Door is W=0.82, H=2.02, centered at (0, 0, 1.02)
# Frame jambs: Left from x = -0.48 to -0.413 (width ~0.067)
#              Right from x = 0.413 to 0.48 (width ~0.067)
# Header: Top from z = 2.033 to 2.12 (height ~0.087)
# Threshold: Bottom from z = 0.0 to 0.008 (height ~0.008)
# Architrave / casing trims give full 0.96 x 0.12 x 2.12 extent
# Rebate / stop on frame: interior door stop strip
# Strike plate on right inner jamb around z = 1.00
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_frame():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Left Jamb
    # Main post: x: [-0.47, -0.413], y: [-0.055, 0.055], z: [0.0, 2.115]
    # Plus architrave trim extending to x=-0.48, y=[-0.06, 0.06], z=[0.0, 2.12]
    # We can model left side assembly:
    # 1. Outer jamb body
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.445, 0.0, 1.06)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.07, 0.11, 2.12, 1.0)))
    # 2. Left casing trim front
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.455, -0.058, 1.06)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.05, 0.006, 2.12, 1.0)))
    # 3. Left casing trim back
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.455, 0.058, 1.06)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.05, 0.006, 2.12, 1.0)))
    # 4. Door stop strip on left jamb (y: [0.015, 0.035], x: [-0.418, -0.408], z: [0.01, 2.03])
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.418, 0.025, 1.02)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.016, 0.02, 2.02, 1.0)))

    # Right Jamb
    # Main post: x: [0.413, 0.47]
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.445, 0.0, 1.06)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.07, 0.11, 2.12, 1.0)))
    # Right casing trim front
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.455, -0.058, 1.06)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.05, 0.006, 2.12, 1.0)))
    # Right casing trim back
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.455, 0.058, 1.06)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.05, 0.006, 2.12, 1.0)))
    # Door stop strip on right jamb
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.418, 0.025, 1.02)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.016, 0.02, 2.02, 1.0)))
    
    # Strike plate on right jamb (recessed into jamb face at x=0.413, y=0.0, z=1.0)
    # The latch bolt enters at x in [0.412, 0.428], strike plate has a hole for the latch!
    # Strike plate face: x=0.414, y=[-0.015, 0.015], z=[0.97, 1.03]
    # Latch bolt is at x=0.415, y=0, z=1.0 with extent 0.03 x 0.02 x 0.025 (x: [0.400, 0.430]).
    # To prevent penetration between frame and latch_bolt at rest, the right jamb must have a mortise pocket or clearance at (0.415, 0.0, 1.0)!
    # Let's make sure the strike plate / jamb has an opening / pocket at x in [0.412, 0.432], y in [-0.012, 0.012], z in [0.985, 1.015].
    # We can create top/bottom/back of strike plate around the latch pocket.
    
    # Top Header
    # Main header: x: [-0.48, 0.48], y: [-0.055, 0.055], z: [2.033, 2.115]
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 2.075)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.96, 0.11, 0.09, 1.0)))
    # Header casing trim front
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.058, 2.085)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.96, 0.006, 0.07, 1.0)))
    # Header casing trim back
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.058, 2.085)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.96, 0.006, 0.07, 1.0)))
    # Header door stop strip
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.025, 2.032)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.82, 0.02, 0.016, 1.0)))

    # Threshold / sill (low at bottom)
    # x: [-0.445, 0.445], y: [-0.055, 0.055], z: [0.0, 0.009]
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.0045)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.83, 0.11, 0.009, 1.0)))

    # Two frame hinge knuckles on the left jamb:
    # Hinge 1 (top): pivot at (-0.41, -0.02, 1.60)
    bmesh.ops.create_cylinder(bm, cap_ends=True, radius=0.007, depth=0.04,
                              matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.411, -0.020, 1.62)))
    # Hinge 2 (bottom): pivot at (-0.41, -0.02, 0.44)
    bmesh.ops.create_cylinder(bm, cap_ends=True, radius=0.007, depth=0.04,
                              matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.411, -0.020, 0.42)))

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('frame')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('frame', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_frame)
    return obj

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. DOOR LEAF
# BBox center: (0.000, 0.000, 1.020), extents: (0.820, 0.040, 2.020)
# Leaf bounds: x in [-0.410, 0.410], y in [-0.020, 0.020], z in [0.010, 2.030]
# Features:
# - Solid core door slab with bevelled recessed panels (upper large panel, lower small panel)
# - Mortise pocket / faceplate on right edge at z=1.0
# - Two hinge leaves on left edge at z=1.60 and z=0.44
# - Spindle hole at (0.33, 0, 1.0) so handle spindle doesn't penetrate door
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_door_leaf():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Door main stiles and rails (to form panels and handle cutouts):
    # Left stile: x: [-0.410, -0.280], y: [-0.020, 0.020], z: [0.010, 2.030]
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.345, 0.0, 1.02)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.13, 0.04, 2.02, 1.0)))
    
    # Right stile: x: [0.280, 0.410], y: [-0.020, 0.020], z: [0.010, 2.030]
    # Note: around z=1.0, handle spindle passes through at x=0.33, y in [-0.02, 0.02].
    # And latch bolt pocket is at x in [0.40, 0.41], y in [-0.01, 0.01], z in [0.985, 1.015].
    # To keep exact clearance with spindle (radius ~0.008 at (0.33, 0.0, 1.0)) and latch (at x=0.415 extending into door):
    # Let's construct right stile in parts (bottom, middle-around-spindle, top) or with clean sub-boxes:
    # Right stile bottom: z: [0.01, 0.94]
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 0.475)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.13, 0.04, 0.93, 1.0)))
    # Right stile top: z: [1.06, 2.03]
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 1.545)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.13, 0.04, 0.97, 1.0)))
    # Right stile middle outer edge (x: [0.36, 0.408], z: [0.94, 1.06]) - keeps clearance for latch bolt at x > 0.40!
    # Latch bolt is at x=0.415, size=(0.03, 0.02, 0.025) -> x: [0.400, 0.430].
    # So latch bolt enters from x=0.400 to 0.410 into door leaf.
    # We leave cavity at x in [0.395, 0.410], z in [0.985, 1.015], y in [-0.012, 0.012] for the latch!
    # Top of lock block (z: 1.015 to 1.06, x: [0.28, 0.41])
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 1.0375)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.13, 0.04, 0.045, 1.0)))
    # Bottom of lock block (z: 0.94 to 0.985, x: [0.28, 0.41])
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.345, 0.0, 0.9625)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.13, 0.04, 0.045, 1.0)))
    # In between z: [0.985, 1.015], lock block inner portion (x: [0.28, 0.315] and [0.345, 0.395])
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.2975, 0.0, 1.0)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.035, 0.04, 0.03, 1.0)))
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.370, 0.0, 1.0)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.05, 0.04, 0.03, 1.0)))

    # Rails (top, mid, bottom) between x: [-0.28, 0.28]
    # Top rail: z: [1.90, 2.03]
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.965)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.56, 0.04, 0.13, 1.0)))
    # Mid rail (lock rail): z: [0.92, 1.08]
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 1.00)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.56, 0.04, 0.16, 1.0)))
    # Bottom rail (kick rail): z: [0.01, 0.18]
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.095)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.56, 0.04, 0.17, 1.0)))

def make_material(name, diffuse_color, roughness=0.4, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if bsdf:
        bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = diffuse_color
        bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
        bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return mat

mat_frame = make_material("MatFrame", (0.92, 0.91, 0.88, 1.0), roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0)
mat_door = make_material("MatDoor", (0.95, 0.94, 0.92, 1.0), roughness=0.35, metallic=0.0)
mat_metal = make_material("MatNickel", (0.75, 0.76, 0.77, 1.0), roughness=0.25, metallic=0.9)

def add_cylinder(bm, radius, depth, matrix=Matrix.Identity(4), segments=16):
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        cap_tris=False,
        segments=segments,
        radius1=radius,
        radius2=radius,
        depth=depth,
        matrix=matrix
    )

def add_box(bm, size, matrix=Matrix.Identity(4)):
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm,
        size=1.0,
        matrix=matrix @ Matrix.Diagonal((size[0], size[1], size[2], 1.0))
    )

# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_lever_handle():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    rot_x = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(90), 4, 'X')
    
    # 1. Spindle: Y-cylinder from y=-0.020 to y=0.018, radius 0.004
    # Sits in mortise hole of door leaf (no overlap with door_leaf mesh)
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.004, depth=0.038, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.001, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    
    # 2. Front Escutcheon Plate (rosette): center (0.330, -0.0225, 1.000), size (0.046, 0.005, 0.080)
    # Overlaps door leaf surface (y=-0.020) by 0.0025 m (touches/welds for connectivity!)
    add_box(bm, (0.046, 0.005, 0.080), Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.0225, 1.000)))
    
    # 3. Front Collar Hub (protrudes forward from rose): y in [-0.075, -0.025], radius 0.009
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.009, depth=0.050, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.050, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    
    # 4. Front Lever Grip: extends to the right (x in [0.260, 0.400]), y centered at -0.083, z in [0.993, 1.007]
    add_box(bm, (0.136, 0.014, 0.014), Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.083, 1.000)))
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.014, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.262, -0.083, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.007, depth=0.014, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.398, -0.083, 1.000)) @ rot_x)
    
    # 5. Back Escutcheon Plate (touching / overlapping back door face at y=0.020):
    # center (0.330, 0.0185, 1.000), size (0.046, 0.003, 0.080)
    add_box(bm, (0.046, 0.003, 0.080), Matrix.Translation((0.330, 0.0185, 1.000)))
    
    # 6. Keyhole detail:
    add_cylinder(bm, radius=0.003, depth=0.006, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.330, -0.024, 0.970)) @ rot_x)

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('lever_handle')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('lever_handle', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_metal)
    return obj

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. LATCH BOLT
# Plan bbox: center (0.415, 0.000, 1.000), extents: (0.030, 0.020, 0.025)
# Bounds: x: [0.400, 0.430], y: [-0.010, 0.010], z: [0.9875, 1.0125]
# When retracted by 0.015 m (moving in -X direction), x range becomes [0.385, 0.415]
# Mortise pocket inside door leaf is clear for x in [0.385, 0.410]!
# Overlaps frame strike hole edge in rest pose (x=0.430 touching strike hole at x=0.435/overlap)
# Overlaps door leaf mortise lips slightly for connectivity.
# -------------------------------------------------------------

def build_latch_bolt():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Main Bolt Body (x in [0.400, 0.424], y in [-0.009, 0.009], z in [0.988, 1.012])
    add_box(bm, (0.024, 0.018, 0.024), Matrix.Translation((0.412, 0.0, 1.000)))
    
    # Beveled Latch Nose (x in [0.424, 0.430]):
    # Slanted front face
    add_box(bm, (0.006, 0.014, 0.024), Matrix.Translation((0.427, -0.002, 1.000)))

    # Auxiliary anti-friction pin / plunger
    add_box(bm, (0.016, 0.003, 0.016), Matrix.Translation((0.415, 0.007, 1.000)))

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('latch_bolt')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('latch_bolt', me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_metal)
    return obj

# Build all links
build_frame()
build_door_leaf()
build_lever_handle()
