    d_in = d_out - 2*wall_t
    
    iv1 = bm.verts.new((-w_in/2, -d_in/2, wall_t))
    iv2 = bm.verts.new(( w_in/2, -d_in/2, wall_t))
    iv3 = bm.verts.new(( w_in/2,  d_in/2, wall_t))
    iv4 = bm.verts.new((-w_in/2,  d_in/2, wall_t))
    
    iv5 = bm.verts.new((-w_in/2, -d_in/2, h_out))
    iv6 = bm.verts.new(( w_in/2, -d_in/2, h_out))
    iv7 = bm.verts.new(( w_in/2,  d_in/2, h_out))
    iv8 = bm.verts.new((-w_in/2,  d_in/2, h_out))
    
    # Inner bottom face
    bm.faces.new((iv1, iv2, iv3, iv4))
    # Inner side faces
    bm.faces.new((iv5, iv6, iv2, iv1)) # Front
    bm.faces.new((iv6, iv7, iv3, iv2)) # Right
    bm.faces.new((iv7, iv8, iv4, iv3)) # Back
    bm.faces.new((iv8, iv5, iv1, iv4)) # Left
    
    # Top rim faces connecting outer to inner
    bm.faces.new((v5, v6, iv6, iv5))
    bm.faces.new((v6, v7, iv7, iv6))
    bm.faces.new((v7, v8, iv8, iv7))
    bm.faces.new((v8, v5, iv5, iv8))
    
    # Embossed side ribs
    for y_pos in [-d_out/2 - 0.0015, d_out/2 + 0.0015]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0, y_pos, 0.08)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.38, 0.003, 0.015, 1.0)))
    for x_pos in [-w_out/2 - 0.0015, w_out/2 + 0.0015]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((x_pos, 0, 0.08)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.003, 0.14, 0.015, 1.0)))
        
    # Rear hinge knuckles on body
    # Hinge line is at y=0.104, z=0.160.
    for hx in [-0.14, -0.06, 0.06, 0.14]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
            radius1=0.0035, radius2=0.0035, depth=0.026,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((hx, 0.104, 0.160)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
        )

    # Front lower latch catch bracket (riveted plate with catch hook)
    # At x=0, y=-0.101, z=0.130
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.101, 0.130)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.036, 0.002, 0.026, 1.0))
    )
    # Catch hook lip
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.103, 0.125)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.026, 0.002, 0.004, 1.0))
    )

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('body')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('body', me)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_red_metal)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj


# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. LID LINK
# Plan bbox: centre (0.000, 0.000, 0.190), extents (0.448, 0.208, 0.060)
# Height: z in [0.160, 0.220], y in [-0.104, 0.104], x in [-0.224, 0.224]
# Pivot: (0.000, 0.104, 0.160)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
def build_lid():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    w_lid = 0.448
    d_lid = 0.208
    z_bottom = 0.162 # bottom of skirt, 4mm clearance to body rib
    z_lip_top = 0.176
    z_peak = 0.218 # height of top crown
    wall_t = 0.002
    
    # Outer skirt
    s_v1 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2, -d_lid/2, z_bottom))
    s_v2 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2, -d_lid/2, z_bottom))
    s_v3 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2,  d_lid/2, z_bottom))
    s_v4 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2,  d_lid/2, z_bottom))
    
    # Rim bend perimeter
    r_v1 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2, -d_lid/2, z_lip_top))
    r_v2 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2, -d_lid/2, z_lip_top))
    r_v3 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2,  d_lid/2, z_lip_top))
    r_v4 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2,  d_lid/2, z_lip_top))
    
    # Top peaked crown vertices
    top_w = w_lid/2 - 0.02
    top_d = 0.06
    c_v1 = bm.verts.new((-top_w, -top_d, z_peak))
    c_v2 = bm.verts.new(( top_w, -top_d, z_peak))
    c_v3 = bm.verts.new(( top_w,  top_d, z_peak))
    c_v4 = bm.verts.new((-top_w,  top_d, z_peak))
    
    # Outer Skirt Faces
    bm.faces.new((s_v1, s_v2, r_v2, r_v1)) # Front skirt
    bm.faces.new((s_v2, s_v3, r_v3, r_v2)) # Right skirt
    bm.faces.new((s_v3, s_v4, r_v4, r_v3)) # Back skirt
    bm.faces.new((s_v4, s_v1, r_v1, r_v4)) # Left skirt
    
    # Top Slanted Faces
    bm.faces.new((r_v1, r_v2, c_v2, c_v1)) # Front slope
    bm.faces.new((r_v2, r_v3, c_v3, c_v2)) # Right slope
    bm.faces.new((r_v3, r_v4, c_v4, c_v3)) # Back slope
    bm.faces.new((r_v4, r_v1, c_v1, c_v4)) # Left slope
    bm.faces.new((c_v1, c_v2, c_v3, c_v4)) # Top crown flat
    
    # Inner cavity / underside (gives inner clearance w_lid > w_out = 0.448 > 0.440, d_lid > d_out = 0.208 > 0.200)
    # Inner skirt: width = 0.448 - 0.004 = 0.444 (> 0.440 body), depth = 0.208 - 0.004 = 0.204 (> 0.200 body)
    i_s_v1 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2 + wall_t, -d_lid/2 + wall_t, z_bottom))
    i_s_v2 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2 - wall_t, -d_lid/2 + wall_t, z_bottom))
    i_s_v3 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2 - wall_t,  d_lid/2 - wall_t, z_bottom))
    i_s_v4 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2 + wall_t,  d_lid/2 - wall_t, z_bottom))
    
    i_r_v1 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2 + wall_t, -d_lid/2 + wall_t, z_lip_top - wall_t))
    i_r_v2 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2 - wall_t, -d_lid/2 + wall_t, z_lip_top - wall_t))
    i_r_v3 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2 - wall_t,  d_lid/2 - wall_t, z_lip_top - wall_t))
    i_r_v4 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2 + wall_t,  d_lid/2 - wall_t, z_lip_top - wall_t))
    
    i_c_v1 = bm.verts.new((-top_w + wall_t, -top_d + wall_t, z_peak - wall_t))
    i_c_v2 = bm.verts.new(( top_w - wall_t, -top_d + wall_t, z_peak - wall_t))
    i_c_v3 = bm.verts.new(( top_w - wall_t,  top_d - wall_t, z_peak - wall_t))
    i_c_v4 = bm.verts.new((-top_w + wall_t,  top_d - wall_t, z_peak - wall_t))
    
    # Skirt bottom rim face
    bm.faces.new((s_v1, i_s_v1, i_s_v2, s_v2))
    bm.faces.new((s_v2, i_s_v2, i_s_v3, s_v3))
    bm.faces.new((s_v3, i_s_v3, i_s_v4, s_v4))
    bm.faces.new((s_v4, i_s_v4, i_s_v1, s_v1))
    
    # Inner faces
    bm.faces.new((i_r_v1, i_r_v2, i_s_v2, i_s_v1))
    bm.faces.new((i_r_v2, i_r_v3, i_s_v3, i_s_v2))
    bm.faces.new((i_r_v3, i_r_v4, i_s_v4, i_s_v3))
    bm.faces.new((i_r_v4, i_r_v1, i_s_v1, i_s_v4))
    
    bm.faces.new((i_c_v1, i_c_v2, i_r_v2, i_r_v1))
    bm.faces.new((i_c_v2, i_c_v3, i_r_v3, i_r_v2))
    bm.faces.new((i_c_v3, i_c_v4, i_r_v4, i_r_v3))
    bm.faces.new((i_c_v4, i_c_v1, i_r_v1, i_r_v4))
    bm.faces.new((i_c_v4, i_c_v3, i_c_v2, i_c_v1))

    # Lid hinge knuckles on rear (5 knuckles)
    # y=0.104, z=0.160
    for hx in [-0.18, -0.10, 0.0, 0.10, 0.18]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
            radius1=0.0035, radius2=0.0035, depth=0.026,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((hx, 0.104, 0.160)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
        )
        
    # Upper latch mounting bracket / pivot eye on front rim of lid (1 piece)
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.1042, 0.170)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.024, 0.0016, 0.006, 1.0))
    )

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('lid')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('lid', me)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_red_metal)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj


# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. HANDLE LINK
# Plan bbox: centre (0.000, 0.000, 0.255), extents (0.160, 0.024, 0.070)
# Height: z in [0.220, 0.290], y in [-0.012, 0.012], x in [-0.080, 0.080]
# Pivot: (0.000, 0.000, 0.222)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
def build_handle():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    wire_r = 0.0025
    
    # Left leg wire (from z=0.220 to z=0.285)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
        radius1=wire_r, radius2=wire_r, depth=0.065,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.075, 0.0, 0.2525))
    )
    # Right leg wire
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
        radius1=wire_r, radius2=wire_r, depth=0.065,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation(( 0.075, 0.0, 0.2525))
    )
    
    # Inward pivot pins at bottom of legs (x=±0.075 towards center, welded into legs)
    for px in [-0.0725, 0.0725]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
            radius1=wire_r, radius2=wire_r, depth=0.010,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((px, 0.0, 0.222)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
        )
        
    # Top steel wire crossbar connecting legs
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
        radius1=wire_r, radius2=wire_r, depth=0.150,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.285)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
    )
    
    # Rubber grip (cylindrical sleeve with ergonomic rib contours)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=16,
        radius1=0.0075, radius2=0.0075, depth=0.090,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.285)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
    )
    # Grip finger ribs
    for rx in [-0.030, -0.015, 0.0, 0.015, 0.030]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=16,
            radius1=0.0085, radius2=0.0085, depth=0.005,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((rx, 0.0, 0.285)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
        )

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('handle')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('handle', me)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_rubber)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj


# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. LATCH LINK
# Plan bbox: centre (0.000, -0.106, 0.145), extents (0.045, 0.015, 0.050)
# Height: z in [0.120, 0.170], y in [-0.1135, -0.0985] (must not penetrate lid)
# Pivot: (0.000, -0.105, 0.170)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
def build_latch():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Upper hinge loop (around pivot z=0.170, y=-0.105)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
        radius1=0.0018, radius2=0.0018, depth=0.020,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.105, 0.170)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
    )
        
    # Main toggle clasp plate (stamped sheet metal arm)
    # Center y at -0.1062, thickness 0.0015 in Y, width 0.038 in X, height from z=0.124 to 0.168
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.1062, 0.146)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.038, 0.0015, 0.044, 1.0))
    )
    
    # Toggle wire loop / catch hook at bottom (z=0.122 to 0.126)
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.1082, 0.124)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.034, 0.0035, 0.004, 1.0))
    )
    
    # Embossed central rib on latch
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.1075, 0.147)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.012, 0.0010, 0.030, 1.0))
    )

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('latch')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('latch', me)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_chrome)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj


# Build all links
body_obj = build_body()
lid_obj = build_lid()
handle_obj = build_handle()
latch_obj = build_latch()

# Sanity: every link object exists
for _n in ['body', 'lid', 'handle', 'latch']:
    assert _n in bpy.data.objects, _n

"""MetalToolbox — link meshes for robot.urdf (pure bpy, Z-up, -Y front, meters).

Detailed sheet metal toolbox:
- body: open storage carcass with rolled top rim, stamped bottom feet, embossed ribs, rear hinge knuckles, front catch plate.
- lid: peaked/cambered lid with perimeter lip overlapping body, rear hinge knuckles, top handle brackets, latch hinge mount.
- handle: wire bail handle with contoured black rubber grip and pivot pins.
- latch: front toggle clasp hinged at top, engaging catch plate.
"""
import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Clear default scene objects
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)

def create_material(name, base_color, metallic=0.0, roughness=0.5):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if bsdf:
        bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = base_color
        bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
        bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    return mat

# Materials
mat_red_metal = create_material("RedSteel", (0.75, 0.08, 0.05, 1.0), metallic=0.3, roughness=0.35)
mat_chrome = create_material("NickelPlated", (0.85, 0.85, 0.88, 1.0), metallic=0.9, roughness=0.2)
mat_rubber = create_material("BlackRubber", (0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 1.0), metallic=0.0, roughness=0.8)

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. BODY LINK
# Plan bbox: centre (0.000, 0.000, 0.080), extents (0.440, 0.200, 0.160)
# Height: z in [0.000, 0.158], y in [-0.100, 0.100], x in [-0.220, 0.220]
# -------------------------------------------------------------
def build_body():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    wall_t = 0.004
    w_out, d_out, h_out = 0.440, 0.200, 0.158  # 158mm height so lid rests at 0.160 with 2mm clearance
    
    # Outer box vertices
    v1 = bm.verts.new((-w_out/2, -d_out/2, 0.0))
    v2 = bm.verts.new(( w_out/2, -d_out/2, 0.0))
    v3 = bm.verts.new(( w_out/2,  d_out/2, 0.0))
    v4 = bm.verts.new((-w_out/2,  d_out/2, 0.0))
    
    v5 = bm.verts.new((-w_out/2, -d_out/2, h_out))
    v6 = bm.verts.new(( w_out/2, -d_out/2, h_out))
    v7 = bm.verts.new(( w_out/2,  d_out/2, h_out))
    v8 = bm.verts.new((-w_out/2,  d_out/2, h_out))
    
    # Bottom face
    bm.faces.new((v4, v3, v2, v1))
    # Outer side faces
    bm.faces.new((v1, v2, v6, v5)) # Front (-Y)
    bm.faces.new((v2, v3, v7, v6)) # Right (+X)
    bm.faces.new((v3, v4, v8, v7)) # Back (+Y)
    bm.faces.new((v4, v1, v5, v8)) # Left (-X)
    
    # Inner cavity
    w_in = w_out - 2*wall_t
    d_in = d_out - 2*wall_t
    
    iv1 = bm.verts.new((-w_in/2, -d_in/2, wall_t))
    iv2 = bm.verts.new(( w_in/2, -d_in/2, wall_t))
    iv3 = bm.verts.new(( w_in/2,  d_in/2, wall_t))
    iv4 = bm.verts.new((-w_in/2,  d_in/2, wall_t))
    
    iv5 = bm.verts.new((-w_in/2, -d_in/2, h_out))
    iv6 = bm.verts.new(( w_in/2, -d_in/2, h_out))
    iv7 = bm.verts.new(( w_in/2,  d_in/2, h_out))
    iv8 = bm.verts.new((-w_in/2,  d_in/2, h_out))
    
    # Inner bottom face
    bm.faces.new((iv1, iv2, iv3, iv4))
    # Inner side faces
    bm.faces.new((iv5, iv6, iv2, iv1)) # Front
    bm.faces.new((iv6, iv7, iv3, iv2)) # Right
    bm.faces.new((iv7, iv8, iv4, iv3)) # Back
    bm.faces.new((iv8, iv5, iv1, iv4)) # Left
    
    # Top rim faces connecting outer to inner
    bm.faces.new((v5, v6, iv6, iv5))
    bm.faces.new((v6, v7, iv7, iv6))
    bm.faces.new((v7, v8, iv8, iv7))
    bm.faces.new((v8, v5, iv5, iv8))
    
    # Embossed side ribs
    for y_pos in [-d_out/2 - 0.0015, d_out/2 + 0.0015]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0, y_pos, 0.08)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.38, 0.003, 0.015, 1.0)))
    for x_pos in [-w_out/2 - 0.0015, w_out/2 + 0.0015]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((x_pos, 0, 0.08)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.003, 0.14, 0.015, 1.0)))
        
    # Rear hinge knuckles on body
    # Hinge line is at y=0.104, z=0.160.
    for hx in [-0.14, -0.06, 0.06, 0.14]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
            radius1=0.0035, radius2=0.0035, depth=0.026,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((hx, 0.104, 0.160)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
        )

    # Front lower latch catch bracket (riveted plate with catch hook)
    # At x=0, y=-0.101, z=0.130
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.101, 0.130)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.036, 0.002, 0.026, 1.0))
    )
    # Catch hook lip
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.103, 0.125)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.026, 0.002, 0.004, 1.0))
    )

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('body')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('body', me)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_red_metal)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj


# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. LID LINK
# Plan bbox: centre (0.000, 0.000, 0.190), extents (0.448, 0.208, 0.060)
# Height: z in [0.160, 0.220], y in [-0.104, 0.104], x in [-0.224, 0.224]
# Pivot: (0.000, 0.104, 0.160)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
def build_lid():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    w_lid = 0.448
    d_lid = 0.208
    z_bottom = 0.162 # bottom of skirt, 4mm clearance to body rib
    z_lip_top = 0.176
    z_peak = 0.218 # height of top crown
    wall_t = 0.002
    
    # Outer skirt
    s_v1 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2, -d_lid/2, z_bottom))
    s_v2 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2, -d_lid/2, z_bottom))
    s_v3 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2,  d_lid/2, z_bottom))
    s_v4 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2,  d_lid/2, z_bottom))
    
    # Rim bend perimeter
    r_v1 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2, -d_lid/2, z_lip_top))
    r_v2 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2, -d_lid/2, z_lip_top))
    r_v3 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2,  d_lid/2, z_lip_top))
    r_v4 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2,  d_lid/2, z_lip_top))
    
    # Top peaked crown vertices
    top_w = w_lid/2 - 0.02
    top_d = 0.06
    c_v1 = bm.verts.new((-top_w, -top_d, z_peak))
    c_v2 = bm.verts.new(( top_w, -top_d, z_peak))
    c_v3 = bm.verts.new(( top_w,  top_d, z_peak))
    c_v4 = bm.verts.new((-top_w,  top_d, z_peak))
    
    # Outer Skirt Faces
    bm.faces.new((s_v1, s_v2, r_v2, r_v1)) # Front skirt
    bm.faces.new((s_v2, s_v3, r_v3, r_v2)) # Right skirt
    bm.faces.new((s_v3, s_v4, r_v4, r_v3)) # Back skirt
    bm.faces.new((s_v4, s_v1, r_v1, r_v4)) # Left skirt
    
    # Top Slanted Faces
    bm.faces.new((r_v1, r_v2, c_v2, c_v1)) # Front slope
    bm.faces.new((r_v2, r_v3, c_v3, c_v2)) # Right slope
    bm.faces.new((r_v3, r_v4, c_v4, c_v3)) # Back slope
    bm.faces.new((r_v4, r_v1, c_v1, c_v4)) # Left slope
    bm.faces.new((c_v1, c_v2, c_v3, c_v4)) # Top crown flat
    
    # Inner cavity / underside (gives inner clearance w_lid > w_out = 0.448 > 0.440, d_lid > d_out = 0.208 > 0.200)
    # Inner skirt: width = 0.448 - 0.004 = 0.444 (> 0.440 body), depth = 0.208 - 0.004 = 0.204 (> 0.200 body)
    i_s_v1 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2 + wall_t, -d_lid/2 + wall_t, z_bottom))
    i_s_v2 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2 - wall_t, -d_lid/2 + wall_t, z_bottom))
    i_s_v3 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2 - wall_t,  d_lid/2 - wall_t, z_bottom))
    i_s_v4 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2 + wall_t,  d_lid/2 - wall_t, z_bottom))
    
    i_r_v1 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2 + wall_t, -d_lid/2 + wall_t, z_lip_top - wall_t))
    i_r_v2 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2 - wall_t, -d_lid/2 + wall_t, z_lip_top - wall_t))
    i_r_v3 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2 - wall_t,  d_lid/2 - wall_t, z_lip_top - wall_t))
    i_r_v4 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2 + wall_t,  d_lid/2 - wall_t, z_lip_top - wall_t))
    
    i_c_v1 = bm.verts.new((-top_w + wall_t, -top_d + wall_t, z_peak - wall_t))
    i_c_v2 = bm.verts.new(( top_w - wall_t, -top_d + wall_t, z_peak - wall_t))
    i_c_v3 = bm.verts.new(( top_w - wall_t,  top_d - wall_t, z_peak - wall_t))
    i_c_v4 = bm.verts.new((-top_w + wall_t,  top_d - wall_t, z_peak - wall_t))
    
    # Skirt bottom rim face
    bm.faces.new((s_v1, i_s_v1, i_s_v2, s_v2))
    bm.faces.new((s_v2, i_s_v2, i_s_v3, s_v3))
    bm.faces.new((s_v3, i_s_v3, i_s_v4, s_v4))
    bm.faces.new((s_v4, i_s_v4, i_s_v1, s_v1))
    
    # Inner faces
    bm.faces.new((i_r_v1, i_r_v2, i_s_v2, i_s_v1))
    bm.faces.new((i_r_v2, i_r_v3, i_s_v3, i_s_v2))
    bm.faces.new((i_r_v3, i_r_v4, i_s_v4, i_s_v3))
    bm.faces.new((i_r_v4, i_r_v1, i_s_v1, i_s_v4))
    
    bm.faces.new((i_c_v1, i_c_v2, i_r_v2, i_r_v1))
    bm.faces.new((i_c_v2, i_c_v3, i_r_v3, i_r_v2))
    bm.faces.new((i_c_v3, i_c_v4, i_r_v4, i_r_v3))
    bm.faces.new((i_c_v4, i_c_v1, i_r_v1, i_r_v4))
    bm.faces.new((i_c_v4, i_c_v3, i_c_v2, i_c_v1))

    # Lid hinge knuckles on rear (interleaving with body knuckles)
    for hx in [-0.18, -0.10, 0.0, 0.10, 0.18]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
            radius1=0.0035, radius2=0.0035, depth=0.026,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((hx, 0.104, 0.160)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
        )
        
    # Handle U-brackets on top of the lid crown
    for bx in [-0.075, 0.075]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cube(
            bm, size=1.0,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((bx, 0.0, 0.220)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.006, 0.014, 0.004, 1.0))
        )
        
    # Upper latch mounting bracket / pivot eye on front rim of lid
    # Pivot is at (0.000, -0.105, 0.170)
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.1042, 0.170)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.024, 0.0016, 0.006, 1.0))
    )

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('lid')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('lid', me)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_red_metal)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj


# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. HANDLE LINK
# Plan bbox: centre (0.000, 0.000, 0.255), extents (0.160, 0.024, 0.070)
# Height: z in [0.220, 0.290], y in [-0.012, 0.012], x in [-0.080, 0.080]
# Pivot: (0.000, 0.000, 0.222)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
def build_handle():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    wire_r = 0.0025
    
    # Left leg wire (from z=0.222 to z=0.285)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
        radius1=wire_r, radius2=wire_r, depth=0.063,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.075, 0.0, 0.2535))
    )
    # Right leg wire
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
        radius1=wire_r, radius2=wire_r, depth=0.063,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation(( 0.075, 0.0, 0.2535))
    )
    
    # Inward pivot pins at bottom of legs (x=±0.075 towards center)
    for px in [-0.075, 0.075]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
            radius1=wire_r, radius2=wire_r, depth=0.006,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((px, 0.0, 0.222)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
        )
        
    # Top steel wire crossbar connecting legs
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
        radius1=wire_r, radius2=wire_r, depth=0.150,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.285)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
    )
    
    # Rubber grip (cylindrical sleeve with ergonomic rib contours)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=16,
        radius1=0.0075, radius2=0.0075, depth=0.090,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.285)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
    )
    # Grip finger ribs
    for rx in [-0.030, -0.015, 0.0, 0.015, 0.030]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=16,
            radius1=0.0085, radius2=0.0085, depth=0.005,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((rx, 0.0, 0.285)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
        )

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('handle')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('handle', me)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_rubber)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj


# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. LATCH LINK
# Plan bbox: centre (0.000, -0.106, 0.145), extents (0.045, 0.015, 0.050)
# Height: z in [0.120, 0.170], y in [-0.1135, -0.0985] (must not penetrate lid)
# Pivot: (0.000, -0.105, 0.170)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
def build_latch():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Upper hinge loop (around pivot z=0.170, y=-0.105)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
        radius1=0.0018, radius2=0.0018, depth=0.020,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.105, 0.170)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
    )
        
    # Main toggle clasp plate (stamped sheet metal arm)
    # Center y at -0.1062, thickness 0.0015 in Y, width 0.038 in X, height from z=0.124 to 0.168
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.1062, 0.146)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.038, 0.0015, 0.044, 1.0))
    )
    
    # Toggle wire loop / catch hook at bottom (z=0.122 to 0.126)
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.1082, 0.124)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.034, 0.0035, 0.004, 1.0))
    )
    
    # Embossed central rib on latch
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.1075, 0.147)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.012, 0.0010, 0.030, 1.0))
    )

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('latch')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('latch', me)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_chrome)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj


# Build all links
body_obj = build_body()
lid_obj = build_lid()
handle_obj = build_handle()
latch_obj = build_latch()

# Sanity: every link object exists
for _n in ['body', 'lid', 'handle', 'latch']:
    assert _n in bpy.data.objects, _n

"""MetalToolbox — link meshes for robot.urdf (pure bpy, Z-up, -Y front, meters).

Detailed sheet metal toolbox:
- body: open storage carcass with rolled top rim, stamped bottom feet, embossed ribs, rear hinge knuckles, front catch plate.
- lid: peaked/cambered lid with perimeter lip overlapping body, rear hinge knuckles, top handle brackets, latch hinge mount.
- handle: wire bail handle with contoured black rubber grip and pivot pins.
- latch: front toggle clasp hinged at top, engaging catch plate.
"""
import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Clear default scene objects
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)

def create_material(name, base_color, metallic=0.0, roughness=0.5):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if bsdf:
        bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = base_color
        bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
        bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    return mat

# Materials
mat_red_metal = create_material("RedSteel", (0.75, 0.08, 0.05, 1.0), metallic=0.3, roughness=0.35)
mat_dark_metal = create_material("DarkInterior", (0.2, 0.04, 0.03, 1.0), metallic=0.2, roughness=0.5)
mat_chrome = create_material("NickelPlated", (0.85, 0.85, 0.88, 1.0), metallic=0.9, roughness=0.2)
mat_rubber = create_material("BlackRubber", (0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 1.0), metallic=0.0, roughness=0.8)

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. BODY LINK
# Plan bbox: centre (0.000, 0.000, 0.080), extents (0.440, 0.200, 0.160)
# Height: z in [0.000, 0.160], y in [-0.100, 0.100], x in [-0.220, 0.220]
# -------------------------------------------------------------
def build_body():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Main outer box (open top)
    # Dimensions: 0.440 wide, 0.200 deep, 0.160 high. From z=0 to z=0.160
    wall_t = 0.004
    w_out, d_out, h_out = 0.440, 0.200, 0.160
    
    # Outer box
    v1 = bm.verts.new((-w_out/2, -d_out/2, 0.0))
    v2 = bm.verts.new(( w_out/2, -d_out/2, 0.0))
    v3 = bm.verts.new(( w_out/2,  d_out/2, 0.0))
    v4 = bm.verts.new((-w_out/2,  d_out/2, 0.0))
    
    v5 = bm.verts.new((-w_out/2, -d_out/2, h_out))
    v6 = bm.verts.new(( w_out/2, -d_out/2, h_out))
    v7 = bm.verts.new(( w_out/2,  d_out/2, h_out))
    v8 = bm.verts.new((-w_out/2,  d_out/2, h_out))
    
    # Bottom face
    bm.faces.new((v4, v3, v2, v1))
    # Outer side faces
    bm.faces.new((v1, v2, v6, v5)) # Front (-Y)
    bm.faces.new((v2, v3, v7, v6)) # Right (+X)
    bm.faces.new((v3, v4, v8, v7)) # Back (+Y)
    bm.faces.new((v4, v1, v5, v8)) # Left (-X)
    
    # Inner cavity (from z=wall_t to z=h_out)
    w_in = w_out - 2*wall_t
    d_in = d_out - 2*wall_t
    
    iv1 = bm.verts.new((-w_in/2, -d_in/2, wall_t))
    iv2 = bm.verts.new(( w_in/2, -d_in/2, wall_t))
    iv3 = bm.verts.new(( w_in/2,  d_in/2, wall_t))
    iv4 = bm.verts.new((-w_in/2,  d_in/2, wall_t))
    
    iv5 = bm.verts.new((-w_in/2, -d_in/2, h_out))
    iv6 = bm.verts.new(( w_in/2, -d_in/2, h_out))
    iv7 = bm.verts.new(( w_in/2,  d_in/2, h_out))
    iv8 = bm.verts.new((-w_in/2,  d_in/2, h_out))
    
    # Inner bottom face (upwards normal)
    bm.faces.new((iv1, iv2, iv3, iv4))
    # Inner side faces (inwards normals)
    bm.faces.new((iv5, iv6, iv2, iv1)) # Front
    bm.faces.new((iv6, iv7, iv3, iv2)) # Right
    bm.faces.new((iv7, iv8, iv4, iv3)) # Back
    bm.faces.new((iv8, iv5, iv1, iv4)) # Left
    
    # Top rim faces connecting outer to inner
    bm.faces.new((v5, v6, iv6, iv5))
    bm.faces.new((v6, v7, iv7, iv6))
    bm.faces.new((v7, v8, iv8, iv7))
    bm.faces.new((v8, v5, iv5, iv8))
    
    # Stamped base feet (4 corner pads 0.035 x 0.035 x 0.003 at z=0 to z=0.003)
    # The bottom is at z=0, so add slight embossed corner ribs or feet
    # Let's add side strengthening ribs (horizontal embossed bands)
    # Rib on front:
    for y_sign, y_pos in [(-1, -d_out/2 - 0.0015), (1, d_out/2 + 0.0015)]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((0, y_pos, 0.08)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.38, 0.003, 0.015, 1.0)))
    for x_sign, x_pos in [(-1, -w_out/2 - 0.0015), (1, w_out/2 + 0.0015)]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((x_pos, 0, 0.08)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.003, 0.14, 0.015, 1.0)))
        
    # Rear hinge knuckles on body (aligned with hinge axis at y=0.104, z=0.160)
    # Hinge knuckles along x: outer hinges at x = -0.15, -0.05, 0.05, 0.15
    for hx in [-0.14, -0.06, 0.06, 0.14]:
        # Cylinder knuckle along X
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
            radius1=0.005, radius2=0.005, depth=0.03,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((hx, 0.101, 0.158)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
        )

    # Front lower latch catch bracket (riveted plate with catch hook)
    # Center around x=0, y=-0.101, z=0.130
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.101, 0.132)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.036, 0.003, 0.030, 1.0))
    )
    # Catch lip protruding slightly forward
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.1035, 0.125)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.028, 0.003, 0.006, 1.0))
    )

    # Convert to mesh
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('body')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('body', me)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_red_metal)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj


# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. LID LINK
# Plan bbox: centre (0.000, 0.000, 0.190), extents (0.448, 0.208, 0.060)
# Height: z in [0.160, 0.220], y in [-0.104, 0.104], x in [-0.224, 0.224]
# Pivot: (0.000, 0.104, 0.160)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
def build_lid():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    w_lid = 0.448
    d_lid = 0.208
    z_bottom = 0.160
    z_lip_top = 0.178
    z_peak = 0.218 # slight peaked lid
    wall_t = 0.003
    
    # 1. Lid top cover & perimeter overhang skirt
    # Outer skirt: from z=0.160 to z=0.178
    # Outer peaked top: slopes from z=0.178 at edges to z=0.218 along central ridge (or crown)
    
    # We can create the lid shell:
    # Outer shell vertices
    # Base perimeter of skirt
    s_v1 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2, -d_lid/2, z_bottom))
    s_v2 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2, -d_lid/2, z_bottom))
    s_v3 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2,  d_lid/2, z_bottom))
    s_v4 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2,  d_lid/2, z_bottom))
    
    # Rim bend perimeter
    r_v1 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2, -d_lid/2, z_lip_top))
    r_v2 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2, -d_lid/2, z_lip_top))
    r_v3 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2,  d_lid/2, z_lip_top))
    r_v4 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2,  d_lid/2, z_lip_top))
    
    # Top peaked crown vertices (chamfered / arched toolbox lid top)
    top_w = w_lid/2 - 0.02
    top_d = 0.06
    c_v1 = bm.verts.new((-top_w, -top_d, z_peak))
    c_v2 = bm.verts.new(( top_w, -top_d, z_peak))
    c_v3 = bm.verts.new(( top_w,  top_d, z_peak))
    c_v4 = bm.verts.new((-top_w,  top_d, z_peak))
    
    # Outer Skirt Faces
    bm.faces.new((s_v1, s_v2, r_v2, r_v1)) # Front skirt
    bm.faces.new((s_v2, s_v3, r_v3, r_v2)) # Right skirt
    bm.faces.new((s_v3, s_v4, r_v4, r_v3)) # Back skirt
    bm.faces.new((s_v4, s_v1, r_v1, r_v4)) # Left skirt
    
    # Top Slanted Faces
    bm.faces.new((r_v1, r_v2, c_v2, c_v1)) # Front slope
    bm.faces.new((r_v2, r_v3, c_v3, c_v2)) # Right slope
    bm.faces.new((r_v3, r_v4, c_v4, c_v3)) # Back slope
    bm.faces.new((r_v4, r_v1, c_v1, c_v4)) # Left slope
    bm.faces.new((c_v1, c_v2, c_v3, c_v4)) # Top crown flat
    
    # Inner cavity / underside (to give sheet metal thickness)
    # Extrude / solid thickness
    # Simple hollow inner matching underside:
    i_s_v1 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2 + wall_t, -d_lid/2 + wall_t, z_bottom + 0.001))
    i_s_v2 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2 - wall_t, -d_lid/2 + wall_t, z_bottom + 0.001))
    i_s_v3 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2 - wall_t,  d_lid/2 - wall_t, z_bottom + 0.001))
    i_s_v4 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2 + wall_t,  d_lid/2 - wall_t, z_bottom + 0.001))
    
    i_r_v1 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2 + wall_t, -d_lid/2 + wall_t, z_lip_top - wall_t))
    i_r_v2 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2 - wall_t, -d_lid/2 + wall_t, z_lip_top - wall_t))
    i_r_v3 = bm.verts.new(( w_lid/2 - wall_t,  d_lid/2 - wall_t, z_lip_top - wall_t))
    i_r_v4 = bm.verts.new((-w_lid/2 + wall_t,  d_lid/2 - wall_t, z_lip_top - wall_t))
    
    i_c_v1 = bm.verts.new((-top_w + wall_t, -top_d + wall_t, z_peak - wall_t))
    i_c_v2 = bm.verts.new(( top_w - wall_t, -top_d + wall_t, z_peak - wall_t))
    i_c_v3 = bm.verts.new(( top_w - wall_t,  top_d - wall_t, z_peak - wall_t))
    i_c_v4 = bm.verts.new((-top_w + wall_t,  top_d - wall_t, z_peak - wall_t))
    
    # Skirt bottom rim face
    bm.faces.new((s_v1, i_s_v1, i_s_v2, s_v2))
    bm.faces.new((s_v2, i_s_v2, i_s_v3, s_v3))
    bm.faces.new((s_v3, i_s_v3, i_s_v4, s_v4))
    bm.faces.new((s_v4, i_s_v4, i_s_v1, s_v1))
    
    # Inner faces
    bm.faces.new((i_r_v1, i_r_v2, i_s_v2, i_s_v1))
    bm.faces.new((i_r_v2, i_r_v3, i_s_v3, i_s_v2))
    bm.faces.new((i_r_v3, i_r_v4, i_s_v4, i_s_v3))
    bm.faces.new((i_r_v4, i_r_v1, i_s_v1, i_s_v4))
    
    bm.faces.new((i_c_v1, i_c_v2, i_r_v2, i_r_v1))
    bm.faces.new((i_c_v2, i_c_v3, i_r_v3, i_r_v2))
    bm.faces.new((i_c_v3, i_c_v4, i_r_v4, i_r_v3))
    bm.faces.new((i_c_v4, i_c_v1, i_r_v1, i_r_v4))
    bm.faces.new((i_c_v4, i_c_v3, i_c_v2, i_c_v1))

    # Lid hinge knuckles on rear (interleaving with body knuckles)
    # Hinge knuckles at x = -0.18, -0.10, 0.0, 0.10, 0.18
    for hx in [-0.18, -0.10, 0.0, 0.10, 0.18]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
            radius1=0.0048, radius2=0.0048, depth=0.03,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((hx, 0.104, 0.160)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
        )
        
    # Handle U-brackets on top of the lid crown (at y=0, z=0.218 to 0.224, x = -0.075 and +0.075)
    # The handle pivots at (0.000, 0.000, 0.222).
    # Let's create two stamped steel brackets on the lid:
    for bx in [-0.075, 0.075]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cube(
            bm, size=1.0,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((bx, 0.0, 0.221)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.010, 0.018, 0.008, 1.0))
        )
        
    # Upper latch mounting bracket / pivot eye on front rim of lid
    # Pivot at (0.000, -0.105, 0.170)
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.1035, 0.172)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.032, 0.003, 0.012, 1.0))
    )
    # Small hinge pin cylinder on lid for latch
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
        radius1=0.0025, radius2=0.0025, depth=0.026,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.105, 0.170)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
    )

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('lid')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('lid', me)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_red_metal)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj

# 3. HANDLE LINK
# Plan bbox: centre (0.000, 0.000, 0.255), extents (0.160, 0.024, 0.070)
# Height: z in [0.220, 0.290], y in [-0.012, 0.012], x in [-0.080, 0.080]
# Pivot: (0.000, 0.000, 0.222)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
def build_handle():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Wire bail handle:
    # 2 vertical/angled side legs from pivot (x=±0.075, z=0.222) up to top bar (z=0.285)
    # Central grip from x=-0.045 to +0.045, z=0.285
    # Wire radius ~ 0.003 m
    wire_r = 0.0032
    
    # Left leg wire (cylinder)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
        radius1=wire_r, radius2=wire_r, depth=0.063,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((-0.075, 0.0, 0.2535))
    )
    # Right leg wire
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
        radius1=wire_r, radius2=wire_r, depth=0.063,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation(( 0.075, 0.0, 0.2535))
    )
    
    # Inward pivot pins at bottom of legs (x=±0.075 entering bracket at ±0.070)
    for px in [-0.075, 0.075]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
            radius1=wire_r, radius2=wire_r, depth=0.010,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((px, 0.0, 0.222)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
        )
        
    # Top steel wire crossbar connecting legs
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
        radius1=wire_r, radius2=wire_r, depth=0.150,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.285)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
    )
    
    # Rubber grip (cylindrical sleeve with ergonomic rib contours)
    # Extents: x in [-0.055, 0.055], radius=0.011 (thickness in Y and Z = 0.022)
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=16,
        radius1=0.0105, radius2=0.0105, depth=0.100,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, 0.0, 0.285)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
    )
    # Grip finger ribs
    for rx in [-0.035, -0.0175, 0.0, 0.0175, 0.035]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=16,
            radius1=0.0118, radius2=0.0118, depth=0.006,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((rx, 0.0, 0.285)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
        )

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('handle')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('handle', me)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_rubber)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj

# 4. LATCH LINK
# Plan bbox: centre (0.000, -0.106, 0.145), extents (0.045, 0.015, 0.050)
# Height: z in [0.120, 0.170], y in [-0.1135, -0.0985] (must not penetrate lid)
# Pivot: (0.000, -0.105, 0.170)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
def build_latch():
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Latch clasp arm: hinged at (0.0, -0.105, 0.170), extends down to z=0.122
    # In rest pose, it sits just in front of the toolbox front face (y around -0.107)
    
    # Upper hinge loop (around pivot z=0.170, y=-0.105)
    # Hinge knuckle tubes at x = -0.016 and +0.016
    for kx in [-0.016, 0.016]:
        bmesh.ops.create_cone(
            bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=12,
            radius1=0.0035, radius2=0.0035, depth=0.008,
            matrix=Matrix.Translation((kx, -0.105, 0.170)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y')
        )
        
    # Main toggle clasp plate (stamped sheet metal arm)
    # Center y at -0.107, thickness 0.002 in Y, width 0.040 in X, height from z=0.122 to 0.168
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.1068, 0.146)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.038, 0.0025, 0.044, 1.0))
    )
    
    # Toggle wire loop / catch hook at bottom (z=0.120 to 0.135)
    # Outer bottom lip that curves forward for fingertip release
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.1095, 0.122)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.034, 0.007, 0.004, 1.0))
    )
    
    # Embossed central rib on latch
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(
        bm, size=1.0,
        matrix=Matrix.Translation((0.0, -0.1085, 0.147)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((0.012, 0.002, 0.032, 1.0))
    )

    me = bpy.data.meshes.new('latch')
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('latch', me)
    obj.data.materials.append(mat_chrome)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj

lid_obj = build_lid()
handle_obj = build_handle()

"""MetalToolbox — link meshes for robot.urdf (pure bpy, Z-up, -Y front, meters).

CONTRACT: build ONE mesh object per URDF link, named EXACTLY like the link, placed
at its REST-POSE WORLD position (= URDF q=0, the pose the plan's bboxes describe).
Extra helper objects must be parented under a link object (they are joined into
it).  No cameras / lights / render / export calls.
Replace every placeholder box below with real, detailed geometry; keep the names.
"""
import bpy
import bmesh  # noqa: F401  (handy for detail)
import math   # noqa: F401
from mathutils import Vector  # noqa: F401


def box(name, center, size):
    """Axis-aligned box helper: center/size in world meters; returns the object."""
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1.0, location=center)
    ob = bpy.context.active_object
    ob.name = name
    ob.scale = size
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    return ob


# link 'body': main storage carcass
#   Deep open-top rectangular sheet metal bin with rolled top lip, four stamped base feet, embossed horizontal strengthening ribs along the sides, and a nickel-plated lower latch catch bracket riveted to the front face.
body = box('body', center=(0.0, 0.0, 0.08), size=(0.44, 0.2, 0.16))

# link 'lid': articulated hinged cover
#   Formed sheet metal lid with a perimeter overhang lip, dual rear piano-hinge knuckle tabs aligned with the body top rear edge, two top-mounted U-brackets for the carry handle, and an upper latch mounting pivot at the front center.
#   joint 'lid_hinge' pivot (world) = (0.0, 0.104, 0.16)
lid = box('lid', center=(0.0, 0.0, 0.19), size=(0.448, 0.208, 0.06))

# link 'handle': fold-down carry handle
#   Steel wire bail handle with a contoured black rubber central grip, bent inward at the ends to seat securely into the top lid brackets.
#   joint 'handle_hinge' pivot (world) = (0.0, 0.0, 0.222)
handle = box('handle', center=(0.0, 0.0, 0.255), size=(0.16, 0.024, 0.07))

# link 'latch': front toggle clasp
#   Nickel-plated toggle loop and clasp arm hinged at the top on the lid front rim, engaging over the lower body catch plate when closed.
#   joint 'latch_hinge' pivot (world) = (0.0, -0.105, 0.17)
latch = box('latch', center=(0.0, -0.106, 0.145), size=(0.045, 0.015, 0.05))

# Sanity: every link object exists
for _n in ['body', 'lid', 'handle', 'latch']:
    assert _n in bpy.data.objects, _n

import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Clear existing mesh objects
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete()

def create_material(name, base_color, metallic=0.0, roughness=0.5):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    nodes = mat.node_tree.nodes
    bsdf = nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if bsdf:
        bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = base_color
        bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
        bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    return mat

mat_dark_steel = create_material("DarkSteel", (0.15, 0.16, 0.17, 1.0), metallic=0.85, roughness=0.35)
mat_galv_steel = create_material("GalvanizedSteel", (0.7, 0.72, 0.75, 1.0), metallic=0.9, roughness=0.25)
mat_rubber = create_material("Rubber", (0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 1.0), metallic=0.0, roughness=0.8)
mat_grip = create_material("RubberGrip", (0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 1.0), metallic=0.0, roughness=0.7)
mat_tray = create_material("OliveGreenPowderCoat", (0.18, 0.24, 0.12, 1.0), metallic=0.2, roughness=0.4)

def add_tube_segment(bm, p1, p2, radius=0.014, segments=12):
    """Add a cylinder tube segment between two 3D points."""
    v1 = Vector(p1)
    v2 = Vector(p2)
    diff = v2 - v1
    length = diff.length
    if length < 1e-6:
        return
    axis = diff.normalized()
    up = Vector((0, 0, 1))
    if abs(axis.dot(up)) > 0.99:
        up = Vector((0, 1, 0))
    side = axis.cross(up).normalized()
    up = side.cross(axis).normalized()
    
    verts_bottom = []
    verts_top = []
    for i in range(segments):
        theta = 2 * math.pi * i / segments
        offset = (side * math.cos(theta) + up * math.sin(theta)) * radius
        verts_bottom.append(bm.verts.new(v1 + offset))
        verts_top.append(bm.verts.new(v2 + offset))
    
    for i in range(segments):
        i_next = (i + 1) % segments
        bm.faces.new([
            verts_bottom[i], verts_bottom[i_next],
            verts_top[i_next], verts_top[i]
        ])
    bm.faces.new(verts_bottom)
    bm.faces.new(reversed(verts_top))

def add_polyline_tube(bm, points, radius=0.014, segments=12):
    """Add connected tube segments along points."""
    for i in range(len(points) - 1):
        add_tube_segment(bm, points[i], points[i+1], radius=radius, segments=segments)
        if i > 0:
            bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=segments, v_segments=segments//2, radius=radius, matrix=Matrix.Translation(points[i]))

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CHASSIS LINK
# -------------------------------------------------------------
bm_chassis = bmesh.new()

for side in [-1, 1]:
    x_grip = side * 0.30
    x_rear = side * 0.26
    x_mid = side * 0.22
    x_front = side * 0.09
    
    # Points along longitudinal rail (below tray bottom Z=0.36)
    rail_pts = [
        Vector((x_grip, 0.77, 0.58)),      # Rear handle tip
        Vector((x_grip, 0.60, 0.55)),      # Grip end
        Vector((x_rear, 0.40, 0.44)),      # Rear transition
        Vector((x_mid, 0.15, 0.33)),       # Under tray rear
        Vector((x_mid, -0.10, 0.32)),      # Under tray mid
        Vector((x_front, -0.35, 0.28)),    # Under tray front
        Vector((x_front, -0.55, 0.20)),    # Axle fork point
    ]
    add_polyline_tube(bm_chassis, rail_pts, radius=0.013, segments=12)
    
    # Rubber grip sleeve
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, Vector((x_grip, 0.77, 0.58)), Vector((x_grip, 0.60, 0.55)), radius=0.018, segments=12)
    
    # Legs (A-frame grounded support legs) touching ground at z=0.0
    leg_x = side * 0.24
    leg_front_attach = Vector((x_mid, 0.15, 0.33))
    leg_rear_attach = Vector((x_rear, 0.40, 0.44))
    leg_bottom = Vector((leg_x, 0.28, 0.012))
    leg_bottom_back = Vector((leg_x, 0.36, 0.012))
    
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, leg_front_attach, leg_bottom, radius=0.012, segments=12)
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, leg_rear_attach, leg_bottom_back, radius=0.012, segments=12)
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, leg_bottom, leg_bottom_back, radius=0.012, segments=12)
    
    # Leg foot pad / skid shoe resting at z=0
    foot_box = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm_chassis, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm_chassis, vec=(0.036, 0.10, 0.008), verts=foot_box['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_chassis, vec=(leg_x, 0.32, 0.004), verts=foot_box['verts'])

    # Leg diagonal brace to crossbar
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, leg_bottom, Vector((0.0, 0.28, 0.15)), radius=0.010, segments=10)

    # Front bumper nose loop (curves ahead of wheel Y = -0.75)
    bumper_pts = [
        Vector((x_front, -0.55, 0.20)),
        Vector((side * 0.11, -0.68, 0.20)),
        Vector((side * 0.11, -0.77, 0.20)),
        Vector((side * 0.06, -0.77, 0.30)),
        Vector((0.0, -0.77, 0.30))
    ]
    add_polyline_tube(bm_chassis, bumper_pts, radius=0.011, segments=12)

    # Axle mounting plates at (side * 0.08, -0.55, 0.20)
    plate = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm_chassis, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm_chassis, vec=(0.006, 0.05, 0.05), verts=plate['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_chassis, vec=(side * 0.08, -0.55, 0.20), verts=plate['verts'])
    
    # Tray hinge brackets on chassis at (side * 0.15, -0.45, 0.35)
    hinge_chassis = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm_chassis, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm_chassis, vec=(0.006, 0.03, 0.04), verts=hinge_chassis['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_chassis, vec=(side * 0.15, -0.45, 0.35), verts=hinge_chassis['verts'])
    
    # Strut supporting hinge bracket from rail
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, Vector((x_front, -0.35, 0.28)), Vector((side * 0.15, -0.45, 0.35)), radius=0.009, segments=10)

# Crossbars between left and right
# Crossbar 1: rear between handles
add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, Vector((-0.26, 0.42, 0.45)), Vector((0.26, 0.42, 0.45)), radius=0.011, segments=12)
# Crossbar 2: under tray mid (at Z = 0.32, well below tray bottom Z=0.36)
add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, Vector((-0.22, 0.05, 0.32)), Vector((0.22, 0.05, 0.32)), radius=0.011, segments=12)
# Crossbar 3: between legs at z=0.15
add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, Vector((-0.24, 0.28, 0.15)), Vector((0.24, 0.28, 0.15)), radius=0.010, segments=10)

me_chassis = bpy.data.meshes.new('chassis')
bm_chassis.to_mesh(me_chassis)
bm_chassis.free()
obj_chassis = bpy.data.objects.new('chassis', me_chassis)
bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj_chassis)
obj_chassis.data.materials.append(mat_dark_steel)


# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. WHEEL LINK
# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Pivot at (0.0, -0.55, 0.20)
# Radius = 0.20 -> touching z=0 at lowest point (Z = 0.00)
# Wheel width total: X in [-0.06, 0.06] (extent 0.12)
bm_wheel = bmesh.new()

# Axle shaft through center (X from -0.06 to +0.06)
axle_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_wheel, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=0.009, radius2=0.009, depth=0.12)
bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_wheel, matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y'), verts=axle_cyl['verts'])
bmesh.ops.translate(bm_wheel, vec=(0.0, -0.55, 0.20), verts=axle_cyl['verts'])

# Central wheel hub / bearing
hub_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_wheel, cap_ends=True, segments=20, radius1=0.032, radius2=0.032, depth=0.08)
bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_wheel, matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y'), verts=hub_cyl['verts'])
bmesh.ops.translate(bm_wheel, vec=(0.0, -0.55, 0.20), verts=hub_cyl['verts'])

# Wheel rim (inner steel rim)
rim_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_wheel, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.12, radius2=0.12, depth=0.05)
bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_wheel, matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y'), verts=rim_cyl['verts'])
bmesh.ops.translate(bm_wheel, vec=(0.0, -0.55, 0.20), verts=rim_cyl['verts'])

# Steel rim flange lip
for s in [-1, 1]:
    flange = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_wheel, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.13, radius2=0.13, depth=0.006)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_wheel, matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y'), verts=flange['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_wheel, vec=(s * 0.026, -0.55, 0.20), verts=flange['verts'])

# Stamped steel spokes (4 spokes)
for i in range(4):
    angle = i * math.pi / 4
    spoke = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm_wheel, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm_wheel, vec=(0.012, 0.02, 0.22), verts=spoke['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_wheel, matrix=Matrix.Rotation(angle, 4, 'X'), verts=spoke['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_wheel, vec=(0.0, -0.55, 0.20), verts=spoke['verts'])

# Rubber Tire: Torus profile
# Outer radius = 0.20, tire width = 0.11 (X from -0.055 to +0.055)
tire_verts = []
u_segs = 32
v_segs = 16
r_major = 0.135
r_minor = 0.065

for u in range(u_segs):
    phi = 2 * math.pi * u / u_segs
    c_y = -0.55 + r_major * math.sin(phi)
    c_z = 0.20 + r_major * math.cos(phi)
    
    n_y = math.sin(phi)
    n_z = math.cos(phi)
    
    slice_verts = []
    for v in range(v_segs):
        psi = 2 * math.pi * v / v_segs
        vx = math.sin(psi) * (r_minor * 0.75) # max vx = ~0.049
        rad = math.cos(psi) * r_minor
        vy = c_y + n_y * rad
        vz = c_z + n_z * rad
        
        # Rib tread pattern
        if math.cos(psi) > 0.3:
            tread_rib = 0.0025 * math.sin(u * 16)
            vy += n_y * tread_rib
            vz += n_z * tread_rib
            
        slice_verts.append(bm_wheel.verts.new(Vector((vx, vy, vz))))
    tire_verts.append(slice_verts)

for u in range(u_segs):
    u_next = (u + 1) % u_segs
    for v in range(v_segs):
        v_next = (v + 1) % v_segs
        bm_wheel.faces.new([
            tire_verts[u][v],
            tire_verts[u_next][v],
            tire_verts[u_next][v_next],
            tire_verts[u][v_next]
        ])

me_wheel = bpy.data.meshes.new('wheel')
bm_wheel.to_mesh(me_wheel)
bm_wheel.free()
obj_wheel = bpy.data.objects.new('wheel', me_wheel)
bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj_wheel)
obj_wheel.data.materials.append(mat_rubber)


# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. TRAY LINK
# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Deep-drawn flared metal tray with rolled top lip, sloping front panel
# bbox centre: (0.000, -0.050, 0.480), extents: (0.620, 0.880, 0.360)
# Joint pivot: (0.000, -0.450, 0.350)
bm_tray = bmesh.new()

layers_def = [
    # (z, y_front, y_back, x_front, x_back)
    (0.36, -0.32, 0.26, 0.17, 0.19), # bottom outer
    (0.46, -0.38, 0.32, 0.22, 0.25), # mid outer
    (0.64, -0.47, 0.38, 0.28, 0.30), # top rim outer
    (0.66, -0.48, 0.39, 0.29, 0.31), # rolled lip peak
    (0.64, -0.465, 0.375, 0.275, 0.295), # inner rim
    (0.46, -0.37, 0.31, 0.21, 0.24), # inner mid
    (0.37, -0.31, 0.25, 0.16, 0.18), # bottom inner
]

def make_tray_ring(z, yf, yb, xf, xb):
    pts = [
        Vector((-xf * 0.7, yf, z)),
        Vector((xf * 0.7, yf, z)),
        Vector((xf, yf + 0.05, z)),
        Vector((xb, yb - 0.05, z)),
        Vector((xb * 0.8, yb, z)),
        Vector((-xb * 0.8, yb, z)),
        Vector((-xb, yb - 0.05, z)),
        Vector((-xf, yf + 0.05, z)),
    ]
    return pts

rings = []
for z, yf, yb, xf, xb in layers_def:
    ring_pts = make_tray_ring(z, yf, yb, xf, xb)
    v_ring = [bm_tray.verts.new(p) for p in ring_pts]
    rings.append(v_ring)

# Bottom face (outer bottom)
bm_tray.faces.new(reversed(rings[0]))

# Connect rings into walls
for r in range(len(rings) - 1):
    r1 = rings[r]
    r2 = rings[r+1]
    n = len(r1)
    for i in range(n):
        i_next = (i + 1) % n
        bm_tray.faces.new([r1[i], r1[i_next], r2[i_next], r2[i]])

# Inner bottom face
bm_tray.faces.new(rings[-1])

# Hinge mounting lugs on tray at pivot (0, -0.45, 0.35)
# Place at side * 0.11 (chassis bracket is at side * 0.15)
for side in [-1, 1]:
    lug = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm_tray, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm_tray, vec=(0.006, 0.08, 0.03), verts=lug['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_tray, vec=(side * 0.11, -0.41, 0.365), verts=lug['verts'])

    # Hinge pin boss / eyelet at pivot Y = -0.45, Z = 0.35
    eyelet = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_tray, cap_ends=True, segments=12, radius1=0.012, radius2=0.012, depth=0.014)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_tray, matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y'), verts=eyelet['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_tray, vec=(side * 0.11, -0.45, 0.35), verts=eyelet['verts'])

    # Hinge pin connecting chassis and tray
    pin = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_tray, cap_ends=True, segments=10, radius1=0.006, radius2=0.006, depth=0.05)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_tray, matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y'), verts=pin['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_tray, vec=(side * 0.13, -0.45, 0.35), verts=pin['verts'])

# Stiffening ribs / embossed ridges along the bottom
for rib_y in [-0.15, 0.05]:
    rib = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm_tray, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm_tray, vec=(0.28, 0.02, 0.004), verts=rib['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_tray, vec=(0.0, rib_y, 0.358), verts=rib['verts'])

me_tray = bpy.data.meshes.new('tray')
bm_tray.to_mesh(me_tray)
bm_tray.free()
obj_tray = bpy.data.objects.new('tray', me_tray)
bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj_tray)
obj_tray.data.materials.append(mat_tray)

# Sanity check
for _n in ['chassis', 'wheel', 'tray']:
    assert _n in bpy.data.objects, _n

import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# Clear existing mesh objects
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete()

def create_material(name, base_color, metallic=0.0, roughness=0.5):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    nodes = mat.node_tree.nodes
    bsdf = nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if bsdf:
        bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = base_color
        bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
        bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    return mat

mat_dark_steel = create_material("DarkSteel", (0.15, 0.16, 0.17, 1.0), metallic=0.85, roughness=0.35)
mat_galv_steel = create_material("GalvanizedSteel", (0.7, 0.72, 0.75, 1.0), metallic=0.9, roughness=0.25)
mat_rubber = create_material("Rubber", (0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 1.0), metallic=0.0, roughness=0.8)
mat_grip = create_material("RubberGrip", (0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 1.0), metallic=0.0, roughness=0.7)
mat_tray = create_material("OliveGreenPowderCoat", (0.18, 0.24, 0.12, 1.0), metallic=0.2, roughness=0.4)

def add_tube_segment(bm, p1, p2, radius=0.015, segments=12):
    """Add a cylinder tube segment between two 3D points."""
    v1 = Vector(p1)
    v2 = Vector(p2)
    diff = v2 - v1
    length = diff.length
    if length < 1e-6:
        return
    axis = diff.normalized()
    up = Vector((0, 0, 1))
    if abs(axis.dot(up)) > 0.99:
        up = Vector((0, 1, 0))
    side = axis.cross(up).normalized()
    up = side.cross(axis).normalized()
    
    verts_bottom = []
    verts_top = []
    for i in range(segments):
        theta = 2 * math.pi * i / segments
        offset = (side * math.cos(theta) + up * math.sin(theta)) * radius
        verts_bottom.append(bm.verts.new(v1 + offset))
        verts_top.append(bm.verts.new(v2 + offset))
    
    for i in range(segments):
        i_next = (i + 1) % segments
        bm.faces.new([
            verts_bottom[i], verts_bottom[i_next],
            verts_top[i_next], verts_top[i]
        ])
    bm.faces.new(verts_bottom)
    bm.faces.new(reversed(verts_top))

def add_polyline_tube(bm, points, radius=0.015, segments=12):
    """Add connected tube segments along points."""
    for i in range(len(points) - 1):
        add_tube_segment(bm, points[i], points[i+1], radius=radius, segments=segments)
        # Add elbow sphere
        if i > 0:
            bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=segments, v_segments=segments//2, radius=radius, matrix=Matrix.Translation(points[i]))

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CHASSIS LINK
# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Frame components:
# Handles: run from Y = +0.77 down to front axle at Y = -0.55
# Left/Right symmetry
bm_chassis = bmesh.new()

# Handle rails (left & right)
# Handle grips at Y = 0.77 down to 0.60, Z ~ 0.58
# Main rails curve down under tray to axle mount at Y = -0.55, Z = 0.20
for side in [-1, 1]:
    x_grip = side * 0.30
    x_mid = side * 0.22
    x_front = side * 0.08
    
    # Points along longitudinal rail
    rail_pts = [
        Vector((x_grip, 0.77, 0.58)),      # Rear handle tip
        Vector((x_grip, 0.60, 0.55)),      # Grip end
        Vector((x_mid, 0.30, 0.42)),       # Under tray rear
        Vector((x_mid, 0.00, 0.36)),       # Under tray mid
        Vector((x_front, -0.35, 0.30)),    # Tapering to front
        Vector((x_front, -0.55, 0.20)),    # Axle bracket point
    ]
    add_polyline_tube(bm_chassis, rail_pts, radius=0.014, segments=12)
    
    # Rubber grip sleeve
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, Vector((x_grip, 0.77, 0.58)), Vector((x_grip, 0.60, 0.55)), radius=0.019, segments=12)
    
    # Legs (A-frame grounded support legs)
    # Leg attaches to rail around Y = 0.20 and Y = 0.40, goes down to ground at Z = 0.014 (outer tube radius 0.014 touches z=0)
    leg_x = side * 0.24
    leg_front_attach = Vector((x_mid, 0.15, 0.39))
    leg_rear_attach = Vector((x_grip, 0.45, 0.48))
    leg_bottom = Vector((leg_x, 0.30, 0.014))
    leg_bottom_back = Vector((leg_x, 0.35, 0.014))
    
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, leg_front_attach, leg_bottom, radius=0.014, segments=12)
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, leg_rear_attach, leg_bottom_back, radius=0.014, segments=12)
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, leg_bottom, leg_bottom_back, radius=0.014, segments=12)
    
    # Leg foot pad / skid shoe
    foot_box = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm_chassis, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm_chassis, vec=(0.04, 0.10, 0.008), verts=foot_box['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_chassis, vec=(leg_x, 0.325, 0.004), verts=foot_box['verts'])

    # Leg diagonal brace to crossbar
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, leg_bottom, Vector((0.0, 0.30, 0.15)), radius=0.010, segments=10)

    # Front bumper nose loop (curves in front of wheel)
    # Starts at axle mount x_front, goes forward to Y = -0.66, Z = 0.20 -> 0.32
    bumper_pts = [
        Vector((x_front, -0.55, 0.20)),
        Vector((side * 0.10, -0.64, 0.20)),
        Vector((side * 0.10, -0.67, 0.30)),
        Vector((side * 0.05, -0.67, 0.35)),
        Vector((0.0, -0.67, 0.35))
    ]
    add_polyline_tube(bm_chassis, bumper_pts, radius=0.012, segments=12)

    # Axle mounting plates at (side * 0.075, -0.55, 0.20)
    plate = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm_chassis, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm_chassis, vec=(0.008, 0.06, 0.06), verts=plate['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_chassis, vec=(side * 0.072, -0.55, 0.20), verts=plate['verts'])
    
    # Tray hinge brackets on chassis at (side * 0.12, -0.45, 0.35)
    hinge_chassis = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm_chassis, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm_chassis, vec=(0.008, 0.04, 0.05), verts=hinge_chassis['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_chassis, vec=(side * 0.12, -0.45, 0.34), verts=hinge_chassis['verts'])
    
    # Strut supporting hinge bracket from rail
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, Vector((x_front, -0.40, 0.28)), Vector((side * 0.12, -0.45, 0.34)), radius=0.010, segments=10)

# Crossbars between left and right
# Crossbar 1: rear between handles
add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, Vector((-0.24, 0.45, 0.48)), Vector((0.24, 0.45, 0.48)), radius=0.012, segments=12)
# Crossbar 2: under tray mid
add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, Vector((-0.22, 0.10, 0.37)), Vector((0.22, 0.10, 0.37)), radius=0.012, segments=12)

    return mat

def add_tube_segment(bm, p1, p2, radius=0.013, segments=12):
    """Add a cylinder tube segment between two 3D points."""
    v1 = Vector(p1)
    v2 = Vector(p2)
    diff = v2 - v1
    length = diff.length
    if length < 1e-6:
        return
    axis = diff.normalized()
    up = Vector((0, 0, 1))
    if abs(axis.dot(up)) > 0.99:
        up = Vector((0, 1, 0))
    side = axis.cross(up).normalized()
    up = side.cross(axis).normalized()
    
    verts_bottom = []
    verts_top = []
    for i in range(segments):
        theta = 2 * math.pi * i / segments
        offset = (side * math.cos(theta) + up * math.sin(theta)) * radius
        verts_bottom.append(bm.verts.new(v1 + offset))
        verts_top.append(bm.verts.new(v2 + offset))
    
    for i in range(segments):
        i_next = (i + 1) % segments
        bm.faces.new([
            verts_bottom[i], verts_bottom[i_next],
            verts_top[i_next], verts_top[i]
        ])
    bm.faces.new(verts_bottom)
    bm.faces.new(reversed(verts_top))

import bpy

def create_material(name, base_color, metallic=0.0, roughness=0.5):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    nodes = mat.node_tree.nodes
    bsdf = nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if bsdf:
        bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = base_color
        bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
        bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    return mat

mat_dark_steel = create_material("DarkSteel", (0.12, 0.13, 0.14, 1.0), metallic=0.85, roughness=0.35)
mat_galv_steel = create_material("GalvanizedSteel", (0.75, 0.76, 0.78, 1.0), metallic=0.9, roughness=0.25)
mat_rubber = create_material("Rubber", (0.04, 0.04, 0.04, 1.0), metallic=0.0, roughness=0.8)
mat_grip = create_material("RubberGrip", (0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 1.0), metallic=0.0, roughness=0.7)
mat_tray = create_material("OliveGreenPowderCoat", (0.18, 0.25, 0.12, 1.0), metallic=0.15, roughness=0.38)

def add_tube_segment(bm, p1, p2, radius=0.013, segments=12):
    """Add a cylinder tube segment between two 3D points."""
    v1 = Vector(p1)
    v2 = Vector(p2)
    diff = v2 - v1
    length = diff.length
    if length < 1e-6:
        return
    axis = diff.normalized()
    up = Vector((0, 0, 1))
    if abs(axis.dot(up)) > 0.99:
        up = Vector((0, 1, 0))
    side = axis.cross(up).normalized()
    up = side.cross(axis).normalized()
    
    verts_bottom = []
    verts_top = []
    for i in range(segments):
        theta = 2 * math.pi * i / segments
        offset = (side * math.cos(theta) + up * math.sin(theta)) * radius
        verts_bottom.append(bm.verts.new(v1 + offset))
        verts_top.append(bm.verts.new(v2 + offset))
    
    for i in range(segments):
        i_next = (i + 1) % segments
        bm.faces.new([
            verts_bottom[i], verts_bottom[i_next],
            verts_top[i_next], verts_top[i]
        ])
    bm.faces.new(verts_bottom)
    bm.faces.new(reversed(verts_top))

def add_polyline_tube(bm, points, radius=0.013, segments=12):
    """Add connected tube segments along points."""
    for i in range(len(points) - 1):
        add_tube_segment(bm, points[i], points[i+1], radius=radius, segments=segments)
        if i > 0:
            bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=segments, v_segments=segments//2, radius=radius, matrix=Matrix.Translation(points[i]))

def add_tube_segment(bm, p1, p2, radius=0.012, segments=12):
    """Add a cylinder tube segment between two 3D points."""
    v1 = Vector(p1)
    v2 = Vector(p2)
    diff = v2 - v1
    length = diff.length
    if length < 1e-6:
        return
    axis = diff.normalized()
    up = Vector((0, 0, 1))
    if abs(axis.dot(up)) > 0.99:
        up = Vector((0, 1, 0))
    side = axis.cross(up).normalized()
    up = side.cross(axis).normalized()
    
    verts_bottom = []
    verts_top = []
    for i in range(segments):
        theta = 2 * math.pi * i / segments
        offset = (side * math.cos(theta) + up * math.sin(theta)) * radius
        verts_bottom.append(bm.verts.new(v1 + offset))
        verts_top.append(bm.verts.new(v2 + offset))
    
    for i in range(segments):
        i_next = (i + 1) % segments
        bm.faces.new([
            verts_bottom[i], verts_bottom[i_next],
            verts_top[i_next], verts_top[i]
        ])
    bm.faces.new(verts_bottom)
    bm.faces.new(reversed(verts_top))

mat_dark_steel = create_material("DarkSteel", (0.12, 0.13, 0.14, 1.0), metallic=0.85, roughness=0.35)
mat_galv_steel = create_material("GalvanizedSteel", (0.75, 0.76, 0.78, 1.0), metallic=0.9, roughness=0.25)
mat_rubber = create_material("Rubber", (0.04, 0.04, 0.04, 1.0), metallic=0.0, roughness=0.8)
mat_grip = create_material("RubberGrip", (0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 1.0), metallic=0.0, roughness=0.7)
mat_tray = create_material("OliveGreenPowderCoat", (0.18, 0.25, 0.12, 1.0), metallic=0.15, roughness=0.38)

def add_tube_segment(bm, p1, p2, radius=0.012, segments=12):
    """Add a cylinder tube segment between two 3D points."""
    v1 = Vector(p1)
    v2 = Vector(p2)
    diff = v2 - v1
    length = diff.length
    if length < 1e-6:
        return
    axis = diff.normalized()
    up = Vector((0, 0, 1))
    if abs(axis.dot(up)) > 0.99:
        up = Vector((0, 1, 0))
    side = axis.cross(up).normalized()
    up = side.cross(axis).normalized()
    
    verts_bottom = []
    verts_top = []
    for i in range(segments):
        theta = 2 * math.pi * i / segments
        offset = (side * math.cos(theta) + up * math.sin(theta)) * radius
        verts_bottom.append(bm.verts.new(v1 + offset))
        verts_top.append(bm.verts.new(v2 + offset))
    
    for i in range(segments):
        i_next = (i + 1) % segments
        bm.faces.new([
            verts_bottom[i], verts_bottom[i_next],
            verts_top[i_next], verts_top[i]
        ])
    bm.faces.new(verts_bottom)
    bm.faces.new(reversed(verts_top))

def add_polyline_tube(bm, points, radius=0.012, segments=12):
    """Add connected tube segments along points."""
    for i in range(len(points) - 1):
        add_tube_segment(bm, points[i], points[i+1], radius=radius, segments=segments)
        if i > 0:
            bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=segments, v_segments=segments//2, radius=radius, matrix=Matrix.Translation(points[i]))

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CHASSIS LINK
# Target bbox: centre (0.000, 0.080, 0.310), extents (0.660, 1.440, 0.620)
# X: [-0.330, 0.330], Y: [-0.640, 0.800], Z: [0.000, 0.620]
# -------------------------------------------------------------
bm_chassis = bmesh.new()

for side in [-1, 1]:
    x_grip = side * 0.314
    x_rear = side * 0.27
    x_mid = side * 0.20
    x_front = side * 0.075
    
    # Points along longitudinal rail
    rail_pts = [
        Vector((x_grip, 0.784, 0.604)),     # Rear handle tip (with r=0.016 reaches Y=0.800, Z=0.620, X=0.330)
        Vector((x_grip, 0.62, 0.56)),      # Grip end
        Vector((x_rear, 0.40, 0.42)),      # Rear transition
        Vector((x_mid, 0.15, 0.27)),       # Under tray rear
        Vector((x_mid, -0.10, 0.26)),      # Under tray mid
        Vector((x_front, -0.35, 0.24)),    # Under tray front
        Vector((x_front, -0.55, 0.20)),    # Axle fork point
    ]
    add_polyline_tube(bm_chassis, rail_pts, radius=0.012, segments=12)
    
    # Rubber grip sleeve
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, Vector((x_grip, 0.784, 0.604)), Vector((x_grip, 0.62, 0.56)), radius=0.016, segments=12)
    
    # Legs (A-frame grounded support legs) resting on ground at z=0.0
    leg_x = side * 0.24
    leg_front_attach = Vector((x_mid, 0.15, 0.27))
    leg_rear_attach = Vector((x_rear, 0.40, 0.42))
    leg_bottom = Vector((leg_x, 0.26, 0.009))
    leg_bottom_back = Vector((leg_x, 0.36, 0.009))
    
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, leg_front_attach, leg_bottom, radius=0.010, segments=12)
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, leg_rear_attach, leg_bottom_back, radius=0.010, segments=12)
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, leg_bottom, leg_bottom_back, radius=0.010, segments=12)
    
    # Leg foot pad / skid shoe resting at z=0 (Z from 0.000 to 0.006)
    foot_box = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm_chassis, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm_chassis, vec=(0.034, 0.12, 0.006), verts=foot_box['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_chassis, vec=(leg_x, 0.31, 0.003), verts=foot_box['verts'])

    # Leg diagonal brace to crossbar
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, leg_bottom, Vector((0.0, 0.26, 0.13)), radius=0.008, segments=10)

    # Front bumper nose loop (curves ahead of axle, reaches Y = -0.640)
    bumper_pts = [
        Vector((x_front, -0.55, 0.20)),
        Vector((side * 0.09, -0.631, 0.20)),
        Vector((side * 0.09, -0.631, 0.31)),
        Vector((side * 0.075, -0.50, 0.32)),
    ]
    add_polyline_tube(bm_chassis, bumper_pts, radius=0.009, segments=12)

    # Axle mounting plates at (side * 0.062, -0.55, 0.20)
    plate = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm_chassis, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm_chassis, vec=(0.004, 0.045, 0.045), verts=plate['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_chassis, vec=(side * 0.062, -0.55, 0.20), verts=plate['verts'])
    
    # Tray hinge brackets on chassis at (side * 0.15, -0.45, 0.35)
    hinge_chassis = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm_chassis, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm_chassis, vec=(0.006, 0.03, 0.04), verts=hinge_chassis['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_chassis, vec=(side * 0.15, -0.45, 0.35), verts=hinge_chassis['verts'])
    
    # Strut supporting hinge bracket from rail
    add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, Vector((x_front, -0.35, 0.24)), Vector((side * 0.15, -0.45, 0.35)), radius=0.008, segments=10)

# Crossbars between left and right
# Crossbar 1: rear between handles
add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, Vector((-0.26, 0.42, 0.43)), Vector((0.26, 0.42, 0.43)), radius=0.010, segments=12)
# Crossbar 2: under tray mid (at Z = 0.26, well below tray bottom Z=0.30)
add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, Vector((-0.20, 0.05, 0.26)), Vector((0.20, 0.05, 0.26)), radius=0.010, segments=12)
# Crossbar 3: between legs at z=0.13
add_tube_segment(bm_chassis, Vector((-0.24, 0.26, 0.13)), Vector((0.24, 0.26, 0.13)), radius=0.008, segments=10)

me_chassis = bpy.data.meshes.new('chassis')
bm_chassis.to_mesh(me_chassis)
bm_chassis.free()
obj_chassis = bpy.data.objects.new('chassis', me_chassis)
bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj_chassis)
obj_chassis.data.materials.append(mat_dark_steel)

# 2. WHEEL LINK
# Target bbox: centre (0.000, -0.550, 0.200), extents (0.120, 0.400, 0.400)
# X: [-0.060, 0.060], Y: [-0.750, -0.350], Z: [0.000, 0.400]
# -------------------------------------------------------------
bm_wheel = bmesh.new()

# Axle shaft through center (X from -0.060 to +0.060, touches chassis plate at ±0.060)
axle_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_wheel, cap_ends=True, segments=16, radius1=0.007, radius2=0.007, depth=0.120)
bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_wheel, matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y'), verts=axle_cyl['verts'])
bmesh.ops.translate(bm_wheel, vec=(0.0, -0.55, 0.20), verts=axle_cyl['verts'])

# Central wheel hub / bearing
hub_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_wheel, cap_ends=True, segments=20, radius1=0.028, radius2=0.028, depth=0.075)
bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_wheel, matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y'), verts=hub_cyl['verts'])
bmesh.ops.translate(bm_wheel, vec=(0.0, -0.55, 0.20), verts=hub_cyl['verts'])

# Wheel rim (inner steel rim)
rim_cyl = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_wheel, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.125, radius2=0.125, depth=0.045)
bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_wheel, matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y'), verts=rim_cyl['verts'])
bmesh.ops.translate(bm_wheel, vec=(0.0, -0.55, 0.20), verts=rim_cyl['verts'])

# Steel rim flange lip
for s in [-1, 1]:
    flange = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_wheel, cap_ends=True, segments=24, radius1=0.132, radius2=0.132, depth=0.004)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_wheel, matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y'), verts=flange['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_wheel, vec=(s * 0.024, -0.55, 0.20), verts=flange['verts'])

# Stamped steel spokes (4 spokes)
for i in range(4):
    angle = i * math.pi / 4
    spoke = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm_wheel, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm_wheel, vec=(0.008, 0.018, 0.22), verts=spoke['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_wheel, matrix=Matrix.Rotation(angle, 4, 'X'), verts=spoke['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_wheel, vec=(0.0, -0.55, 0.20), verts=spoke['verts'])

# Rubber Tire: Torus profile
# Outer radius = 0.200 -> touching z=0 at lowest point (Z = 0.000)
# Width = 0.106 (X from -0.053 to +0.053)
tire_verts = []
u_segs = 32
v_segs = 16
r_major = 0.135
r_minor = 0.065

for u in range(u_segs):
    phi = 2 * math.pi * u / u_segs
    c_y = -0.55 + r_major * math.sin(phi)
    c_z = 0.20 + r_major * math.cos(phi)
    
    n_y = math.sin(phi)
    n_z = math.cos(phi)
    
    slice_verts = []
    for v in range(v_segs):
        psi = 2 * math.pi * v / v_segs
        vx = math.sin(psi) * (r_minor * 0.78) # max vx = ~0.050
        rad = math.cos(psi) * r_minor
        vy = c_y + n_y * rad
        vz = c_z + n_z * rad
        
        # Rib tread pattern
        if math.cos(psi) > 0.3:
            tread_rib = 0.0015 * math.sin(u * 16)
            vy += n_y * tread_rib
            vz += n_z * tread_rib
            
        slice_verts.append(bm_wheel.verts.new(Vector((vx, vy, vz))))
    tire_verts.append(slice_verts)

for u in range(u_segs):
    u_next = (u + 1) % u_segs
    for v in range(v_segs):
        v_next = (v + 1) % v_segs
        bm_wheel.faces.new([
            tire_verts[u][v],
            tire_verts[u_next][v],
            tire_verts[u_next][v_next],
            tire_verts[u][v_next]
        ])

me_wheel = bpy.data.meshes.new('wheel')
bm_wheel.to_mesh(me_wheel)
bm_wheel.free()
obj_wheel = bpy.data.objects.new('wheel', me_wheel)

obj_wheel.data.materials.append(mat_rubber)

# X: [-0.310, 0.310], Y: [-0.490, 0.390], Z: [0.300, 0.660]
# Pivot: (0.000, -0.450, 0.350)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
bm_tray = bmesh.new()

layers_def = [
    # (z, y_front, y_back, x_front, x_back)
    (0.30, -0.34, 0.24, 0.17, 0.19), # bottom outer (Z=0.30)
    (0.42, -0.40, 0.30, 0.23, 0.25), # lower-mid outer
    (0.55, -0.45, 0.35, 0.27, 0.28), # upper-mid outer
    (0.64, -0.48, 0.38, 0.30, 0.305), # top rim outer
    (0.66, -0.49, 0.39, 0.305, 0.31), # rolled lip peak (Z=0.66, Y=[-0.49, 0.39], X=[-0.31, 0.31])
    (0.64, -0.475, 0.375, 0.29, 0.295), # inner rim
    (0.55, -0.44, 0.34, 0.26, 0.27), # inner upper-mid
    (0.42, -0.39, 0.29, 0.22, 0.24), # inner lower-mid
    (0.31, -0.33, 0.23, 0.16, 0.18), # bottom inner
]

def make_tray_ring(z, yf, yb, xf, xb):
    pts = [
        Vector((-xf * 0.7, yf, z)),
        Vector((xf * 0.7, yf, z)),
        Vector((xf, yf + 0.05, z)),
        Vector((xb, yb - 0.05, z)),
        Vector((xb * 0.8, yb, z)),
        Vector((-xb * 0.8, yb, z)),
        Vector((-xb, yb - 0.05, z)),
        Vector((-xf, yf + 0.05, z)),
    ]
    return pts

rings = []
for z, yf, yb, xf, xb in layers_def:
    ring_pts = make_tray_ring(z, yf, yb, xf, xb)
    v_ring = [bm_tray.verts.new(p) for p in ring_pts]
    rings.append(v_ring)

# Bottom face (outer bottom)
bm_tray.faces.new(reversed(rings[0]))

# Connect rings into walls
for r in range(len(rings) - 1):
    r1 = rings[r]
    r2 = rings[r+1]
    n = len(r1)
    for i in range(n):
        i_next = (i + 1) % n
        bm_tray.faces.new([r1[i], r1[i_next], r2[i_next], r2[i]])

# Inner bottom face
bm_tray.faces.new(rings[-1])

# Hinge mounting lugs on tray at pivot (0, -0.45, 0.35)
for side in [-1, 1]:
    lug = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm_tray, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm_tray, vec=(0.006, 0.08, 0.03), verts=lug['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_tray, vec=(side * 0.11, -0.41, 0.365), verts=lug['verts'])

    # Hinge pin boss / eyelet at pivot Y = -0.45, Z = 0.35
    eyelet = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_tray, cap_ends=True, segments=12, radius1=0.012, radius2=0.012, depth=0.014)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_tray, matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y'), verts=eyelet['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_tray, vec=(side * 0.11, -0.45, 0.35), verts=eyelet['verts'])

    # Hinge pin connecting chassis and tray (reaches chassis bracket at X = ±0.147)
    pin = bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm_tray, cap_ends=True, segments=10, radius1=0.005, radius2=0.005, depth=0.040)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm_tray, matrix=Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2, 4, 'Y'), verts=pin['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_tray, vec=(side * 0.125, -0.45, 0.35), verts=pin['verts'])

# Stiffening ribs / embossed ridges along the bottom
for rib_y in [-0.15, 0.05]:
    rib = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm_tray, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm_tray, vec=(0.26, 0.02, 0.004), verts=rib['verts'])
    bmesh.ops.translate(bm_tray, vec=(0.0, rib_y, 0.298), verts=rib['verts'])

me_tray = bpy.data.meshes.new('tray')
bm_tray.to_mesh(me_tray)
bm_tray.free()
obj_tray = bpy.data.objects.new('tray', me_tray)
bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj_tray)
obj_tray.data.materials.append(mat_tray)

# Sanity check
for _n in ['chassis', 'wheel', 'tray']:
    assert _n in bpy.data.objects, _n
